footnotes.text: The writer is thirsty like a thirsty deer in the wilderness, but he is not thirsty for water. He is thirsty for God. He wants to come near to God again, as he remembers he did in the past.

The writer remembers how he worshipped God in the temple. There were crowds of people there. It was like a great party or festival. But now he is far away from God's temple in Jerusalem. So he is very sad.

A waterfall is a place where a river's water pours over the edge of a big rock. The water makes a lot of noise as it falls over the edge. The Jordan River started at Mount Hermon. When it rained a lot the river poured over the rocks and made waterfalls.
Now the writer realizes that God is with him, even when he is far away from Jerusalem. God does not only live in Jerusalem. God is everywhere.

verses.text: My God, show that I am not guilty.Make the people who do not respect youknow that I am right. Rescue me from the evil peoplewho tell lies about me.
God, you are the safe place where I can hide.Why have you pushed me away?How much longer must I continue to weep,because my enemies do cruel things to me?
Send me your light and your truth.Let them be my guide.They will take me back to your holy mountainand to the house where you live.
Then I will go to your altar,to worship you, the God who makes me happy.You are my God and I will praise you there.I will sing to thank you, God, with my harp.
I ask myself,‘Why am I so sad and upset?’I must wait patiently for God to help me.Then I will praise my God once again,because he is the one who saves me.

headings.text: A prayer in a time of trouble
Psalm 43 probably continues from Psalm 42 as one psalm.

footnotes.text: The writer prays for God to send light and truth. He wants God to show him the way back to Jerusalem. That is where the holy mountain and the house of God are. The holy mountain is Mount Zion, where the temple was.

verses.text: God, we have heard it for ourselves.Our ancestors told uswhat you did for them a long time ago.
You used your power to chase away the other nations,so that our ancestors could live in their land.You punished those nations,and you helped our ancestors to be free.

Our ancestors did not get the landby the power of their own swords.Their own strength did not win the fight.It was your own power and strength that did it!You were kind to them because you were their friend.
God, you are my king!You command that Jacob's descendantsmust win against their enemies.
Because of your power,we can knock down our enemies.Because of your strength,we can beat them down.
I do not trust in my bow and arrows.It is not my swordthat has helped me to win the fight.
It is you who rescues us from our enemies.You bring shame on the people that hate us.
Every day, we praise you, God.We will always thank you, all the time,because you are great!
But now you have turned against us.You have made us ashamed.When our armies go out to fight a battle,you no longer go with us.
You make us run away from our enemies.The people who hate us take from us whatever they like!
You have put us under their power,so that they kill us like sheep for them to eat.You have sent us awayto live in foreign countries.
You have sold your own people,for almost nothing!They had no value to you.
The people who live in countries near usdo not respect us.They laugh at us and they insult us.
The other nations tell jokes about us.They think that we are nothing.
I feel ashamed all the time.I do not know where to look.
This is because my cruel enemies are always insulting me.All they want is to hurt me.
We have not turned away from you,but all this has happened to us.We have not turned against the covenant that you made with us.
We have continued to serve youand we obey your commands.
But you have broken us in pieces.You have left us for wild dogs to eat.You have covered us with the darkness of death.
We might have turned against you, our God,and worshipped a strange god.
But if we had done that,you would have discovered it.You know even our most secret thoughts.
But, because we are your people, God,people try to kill us all the time.They think that we are like sheepand we are ready to be killed.
Lord God, do something!Why are you sleeping? Wake up!Do not turn away from us for ever!
Why do you turn away from us?Why do you forget our troublesand the way that people hurt us?
We have fallen down in the dirt.Our bodies are lying on the ground.
Wake up and help us!Save us, because of your faithful love.

headings.text: A prayer that God will help quickly

Verses 1-8 tell us what God did for the Israelites when they came into the land that he had promised to give to them, Canaan. They did not win the land for themselves, but God gave it to them. Their enemies were the people who lived in the land before they arrived there. In verses 9-22 we read that something bad has happened. The people are saying that they obeyed their part of the
covenant
, but God still did not take care of them. In verses 23-26 the person who wrote the psalm prays. He asks God to send help quickly.

verses.text: This beautiful song makes me feel very happy.I will sing this special poem to the king.My voice is ready to sing it very well,as well as a clever writer can write with a pen.
You are the most handsome man that there is.You speak kind words in a beautiful way.And so God will continue to bless you for ever.
Brave soldier, wear your sword at your side!Show what a great king you are!
Wear your royal clothesand ride out to win against your enemies!Win the war on behalf of truth and justice!Then your strong right hand will do powerful things!
Your sharp arrows will cut into the heart of your enemies. Nations will fall down under your feet.
God, you will continue to rule as kingalways and for ever.Your authority as king will bring justice to your people.
You love people to do what is right,and you hate anything that is evil.So God, your God, has chosen youto be greater than all your people.He has put special olive oil on you,to make you happy.
All your clothes have the beautiful smellof myrrh, aloes and cassia. You hear the music of stringed instrumentsthat comes from beautiful palaces.That makes you happy.
The daughters of kings are among your visitors.Your royal bride stands at your right side.She is wearing gold from Ophir.
Royal daughter, listen to me.Listen carefully to what I am saying.Forget your people and your family.
You are very beautifuland the king will want to be with you.He is your master, so respect him.
Rich people will come from Tyre to give gifts to you.They will want you to help them.
The king's bride is in the palace,and she looks beautiful!Her dress has gold threads in it.
Now they lead her to the king in her beautiful clothes.Her young friends follow after herto bring her to the king.
They are very happy as they walk togetherand they go into the king's palace.
You will have sons to become kings,as your ancestors were kings before you.You will make them princesto rule over all the land.
In future years I will cause people to rememberthat you are a great king!Then people will praise you always and for ever.

headings.text: A song for a royal wedding
The king in verses 2-9 was a king that God had chosen to rule his people. The
queen
in verses 10-15 was the woman that the king married. Verses 2-9 are words that the writer says to the king. Verses 10-12 are words that the writer says to the queen.

footnotes.text: Myrrh, aloes and cassia are plants or spices which have a nice smell.
‘threads’ are very thin strings of material.

verses.text: God is a strong place for us,where he will keep us safe.He will always help uswhen troubles come.
So even when the earth shakes,we will not be afraid.And when the mountains fall down into the deep sea,we will still not be afraid.
If the sea makes dangerous waves,so that even the mountains shake,we will never be afraid.
There is a river that runs into the city of God,and it brings God's blessing to the people there.That is the holy placewhere the Most High God lives.
God is in that city.Nothing can ever destroy it.When dawn comes, God will be there to help it.
Nations are shouting with anger! Kingdoms shake and fall.God calls in a loud voice,and even the earth melts!
The Lord Almighty is there to help us.The God of Jacob keeps us safe.
Come and see the great thingsthat the Lord has done.He has brought terrible things to the earth!
All over the world, he causes wars to finish.He destroys the soldiers' bows and spears.He burns their shields in a fire.
He says, ‘Be still and quiet!Understand that I am God.I rule as king over the nations.All the world will say that I am great.’
The Lord Almighty is there to help us.The God of Jacob keeps us safe.

headings.text: The city of God is a strong, safe place
The city of Jerusalem is a picture of God's people. God keeps his own people safe and makes them happy.

verses.text: People from every nation, clap your hands together.Shout aloud to God,with the sound of happy songs.
The Lord, the Most High God, is wonderful.He is the great Kingwho rules over the whole earth.
He has won the battle against our enemies,and those nations are now under our power.
He chose a special land to belong to us.Jacob's descendants are proud of that land.They are his own people that he loves.
God has gone up to sit on his throne,while the people shout aloud.The Lord has gone up there,while the trumpets make a loud noise.
Sing to praise God! Yes, sing!Sing to praise our king! Sing!
God is the King who rules over the whole earth!So sing a special song to praise him!
God rules over the nations.God is sitting on his holy throne.

The leaders of the nations have met together.They have joined with the people who serve Abraham's God. God has authority over all the world's rulersand their armies.Everyone should praise him,for he is great!

headings.text: God rules over all the earth

footnotes.text: Abraham was the first ancestor of the Israelite nation, and of other nations. He was the father of Isaac and the grandfather of Jacob. People from all nations, who are not descendants of Abraham, have joined with the Israelites to worship the Lord.

verses.text: The Lord is great.He deserves people to praise himin the city of our God,on his holy mountain.
That place is high up and it is beautiful.It brings joy to the whole world. Mount Zion is the city of the great King.It is where the true God lives.
God is there in its strong placesand he keeps the city safe.
Look! There are kings of other nationswho join together to attack our city.
But when they come near and they see it,they are very surprised.It frightens them so muchthat they quickly run away!
They cannot stop themselves shaking,like a woman who is giving birth to a baby!
You push them away,like an east wind that destroys great ships.
We had heard about the great things that God has done.Now we have seen them for ourselves,here in the city of the Lord Almighty,the city of our God.It is God who keeps the city safe for ever!
When we are in your temple, God,we think about your faithful love.
You are famous all over the world,so that people praise you as you deserve.You are powerfuland you rule with justice.
Because you judge people in a right way, Mount Zion and all the towns of Judah will be happy.
Walk all around Zion and look at it.Count the towers.
Look at its strong buildings and its strong walls.Then you will be able to describe it to your children.
Yes, this is our God, who is with us for ever!He will always be our guide.

headings.text: Zion is God's own city

footnotes.text: Mount Zion was the place in Jerusalem where they built the temple. It was the home of Israel's true God.
Judah was the land that belonged to Judah's tribe. It became the name for the Israelite kingdom in the south. Jerusalem was its capital city.

verses.text: Listen to this, people from every nation.Yes, listen carefully,everyone who lives in this world!
All people must listen, whoever you are,whether you are rich people or poor people.
I will speak wise words to you.When you know my thoughts,you will understand things better.
I have studied proverbs.I explain what they meanas I make music on my harp.
When trouble comes,why am I afraid?When cruel people are all around me,and they want to hurt me,why am I afraid?
Those people think that their money will keep them safe.They are proud about their riches.
Nobody can pay the price to save another person.Nobody can pay God the price for their life.
A human life costs too much to buy it back.Nobody could ever pay enough.
So nobody can live for ever.Everyone goes to their grave one day.
Surely you see that even wise people die,in the way that fools and stupid people also die.Then their money will belong to someone else.
Their graves will be their homes for ever.They had their own land,which was called by their name,
but people do not live for ever,even if they are very rich.They will die, just like the animals.
The same thing will happen to fools,and to those who copy their way of life.

They will follow one another like sheep.Death will be their shepherdthat leads them into their graves.But when the day arrives, righteous people will rule over them.They will no longer live in their great houses.Death will destroy their bodies in their graves.
But God will save my life from the power of death.He will take me to a safe place with him.
If somebody becomes richand he has more and more things,do not be afraid!
He cannot take anything with him when he dies.His riches cannot go with him into death.
While he lived, he was happy with his life.He thought, ‘People will praise me,because I am rich.’
But he will join his ancestors in death.He will never see the light of day again.
Rich people do not always understand the truth.They will die, just like the animals.

headings.text: Riches cannot save people from death

verses.text: God, the great God, the Lord, is speaking.He is calling everybody on the earth,from where the sun rises in the east,to where it goes down in the west.
God is shining out from Zion,that most beautiful place.
Our God is coming,and he does not come quietly!A fire burns up everything that is in front of him.There is a great storm all around him.
He calls to the skies above,and to the earth below.They must watch while he judges his people.
He says, ‘Bring my people to me.They are the people who offered sacrifices to me,to agree our covenant.’
The skies above show that God is righteous,and God himself is the judge.
He says, ‘Listen to me, my people,and I will speak to you.I have something to say against you, Israel.I am God, your God.
You offer sacrifices and burnt offerings to me all the timebut that is not why I speak against you.
I do not need a bull from your farm,or goats from your fields.
All the wild animals of the forest belong to me!All the cows on a thousand hills belong to me!
I know every bird in the mountains,as well as all the insects.
Even if I did become hungry,I would not tell you.All the world belongs to me,and everything that is in it.
Do I eat the meat of bulls? No!Do I drink the blood of goats? No!
Say “thank you” to me as your offering.Do whatever you have promised to do for me,the Most High God.
Pray to me when you are in trouble.Then I will rescue you,and you will praise me.’
But God says this to the wicked people:‘It is useless for you to speak about my commands,or about my covenant.
For you hate my teaching,and you refuse to accept my message.
If you see a robber,you run to help him!You become friends with adulterers.
You speak about evil things,and you are always telling lies.
You say bad things about your own brother,and you speak against your own family!
You did all these things,and I said nothing.So you thought that I was as bad as you are.But now I am warning you!I will tell you clearlywhat you have done wrong.
So think carefully about this,all you people who have turned away from me.If not, I will tear you into pieces,and nobody will be able to save you.
If anyone wants to praise me,they should say “thank you” to me as their offering.If anyone obeys my commands,I will show them my power to save people.’

headings.text: God is the judge of all people
This psalm is a picture of a
court
of law, where a
judge
decides whether someone has done right or wrong.

footnotes.text: God says that there is nothing wrong with their sacrifices, but he does not need them. He wants us to say ‘thank you’ to him. That is the offering that he wants to receive from his people.

verses.text: Please forgive me, God,because of your faithful love.Because you are so kind,please clean away my sins.
I have done bad things,so wash me to make me clean again.
I know that I have not obeyed you.I cannot forget that I am guilty.
It is you that I have done bad things against,only you! I have done things that are evil,as you know.And so you are fair when you speak against me.You are right when you say that I am guilty.
Yes, even from the day I was bornI have done bad things.I have always been guilty of sin.
But you want me to be completely good and honest.You want to teach me to be wisein the way that I live.
Splash water over me with a hyssop plant,and I will be really clean. Wash me and I will be whiter than snow.
Please forgive me so that I can be happy.Then my whole body will feel well again.
Hide your face from my sins.Clean away all the bad things that I have done.
God, please make me completely pure, deep inside me.Make my spirit strong and true.
Do not send me away from you.Do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.
Give me joy again,because you have made me safe.Make me strong and ready to obey you.
Then I will teach your waysto people who have turned against you.Then sinners will turn backand they will obey you.
God, I am guilty of murder.Please forgive me!You are the one who saves me.When you rescue me,I will sing aloud about your righteousness.
Lord God, help me to speak,and then I will praise you.
I would be happy to offer sacrifices to you,but that is not what you really want.You do not want a burnt offering from me.
You want me to be humble and sorry.That is the sacrifice that you want.When people are humbleand they turn away from their sins,you will not refuse them.
God, please be kind and help Zion.Make the walls of Jerusalem strong again.
Then you will accept our proper sacrifices.Our burnt offerings and sacrifices of whole animalswill make you happy.Once again, people will offer bulls to you,on your altar.

headings.text: King David asks God to forgive him
David wrote this psalm after he had done something very bad. Then God's
prophet
Nathan came to David and he
warned
David. After that, David was very sorry for the bad things that he had done. He asked God to
forgive
him. See

footnotes.text: 2 Samuel 11–12
David knows that sin makes him guilty in front of God. It is like he is dirty, so he wants God to wash away the bad things. Then he will be clean.
David realizes that, more than anything else, it is God that he has turned against.
See Exodus 12:22; Leviticus 14:4-6,49-52; Numbers 19:6-18. Hyssop was a plant that the Israelites used to splash blood or water on things as a sign that God would make them pure.
‘Whiter than snow’ means ‘very pure and clean.’
‘Hide your face’ means ‘look away from me’.
When people were humble and they were sorry for their sins, then God would accept their sacrifices.

verses.text: Strong man, why are you so proudabout the evil things that you like to do?Remember that God's faithful love keeps me safe.
Your tongue is like a sharp knife!You talk about how to hurt other people,You speak nothing but lies.
You love to do evil things,not good things.You love to tell liesmore than the truth.
You love to say cruel words.You speak to deceive others.
But God will knock you down,and he will break you into pieces.He will take you away from your home.He will remove you from this world where people live.
Righteous people will see what has happened,and they will be afraid.Then they will laugh at the wicked person,and they will say,
‘Look! This man did not trust God to keep him safe.Instead, he trusted in his riches.He thought that he could be cruel,and that would keep him safe.’
But I am like a strong olive treethat grows in the house of God.I will always trust in God's faithful love for his people.
I will always praise you, God,for what you have done.I will trust you to help me,together with all those who serve you.

headings.text: God's faithful love wins
King Saul was trying to kill David. David and his men ran away from Saul. Doeg told Saul where he could find David. See

footnotes.text: 1 Samuel 21:7

verses.text: A fool thinks that there is no God.People like that are bad.They do evil things.None of them does anything that is good.
God looks down from heavenat the people on earth.He wants to see if there is anyone who is really wiseand who wants to know God.
But they have all turned away.They have all become evil.Nobody does anything that is good,not even one person.
People who do wicked things understand nothing.They destroy my peopleas easily as they eat bread.They never pray to God.

But now they are very afraidwhen there is nothing to be afraid of!God has completely won against his enemies,the people that attack you, his people.God has turned against them,so you are able to make them ashamed!

God, you are the one who saves your people, Israel!Leave your home in Zionand make your people strong again!When God blesses his people,Jacob's descendants will sing!Yes, Israel's people will be very happy!

headings.text: God wins against wicked people
Psalm 53 is nearly the same as Psalm 14.

footnotes.text: Jacob's descendants and Israel's people are both names for God's people. God changed Jacob's name to ‘Israel’.

verses.text: God, you are great, so please help me!Use your power to show that I am right.
God, hear my prayer,and listen carefully to what I am saying.
Strangers are attacking me! Cruel people want to kill me.They do not respect you, God.
But I know that God is the one who gives me help.My Lord God takes care of me.
Pay back my enemies with their own evil.Please do what you have promisedand destroy them.
I choose to offer a sacrifice to thank you. Lord, you are always good,so I want to praise your name.
Yes, God has saved me from all my trouble.When I looked at my enemies,I see that I have won against them.

headings.text: God keeps his people safe

Saul wanted to kill David. David went to Ziph to hide from Saul. Ziph was near where David's family lived. David gave help to the people of Ziph to fight their enemies. But the men of Ziph told Saul where David was.

footnotes.text: In verses 1-3 David knows what God is like, so he asks God for help.
In verses 4-7 David has received God's help, so he praises God for who he is (his name).

verses.text: God, listen to my prayer.Do not turn awaywhen I ask you to help me.
Listen carefully and answer me.I am very upset because of all my troubles,which are too many for me.
I am afraid because of what my enemies say.Those wicked people give me much pain.They are so angry that they hate meand they give me nothing but trouble.
My heart beats fast inside me.Death seems very near,and I am very afraid.
I am shaking with fear!My troubles are too much for me.
So I say, ‘If I had wings to fly like a dove,I would fly away to a safe place.
Yes! I would go far away,and I would live in the wilderness.
I would go quickly to a safe place.The strong winds and storms of my enemieswould not reach me there!’
My Lord God, make my enemies confused!Stop them from doing what they want to do.Everywhere that I look in the city,I see that they do cruel things to attack people.
They walk on the city's wallsin the day and at night.Inside the city they do evil thingsthat bring trouble everywhere.
They destroy everything!In all the city's streets, they move freely.They hurt people and they cheat them.
But it is not my enemies that have insulted me.That would not have hurt me.If my enemy laughs at me,I can always hide from him!
But it is you, my best friend!We did things as men together,and I trusted you!
We enjoyed our time together.We often went to God's temple,and we joined with the crowd of people there.
Please let death suddenly destroy my enemies!May they go down into their graves alive!They are at home with evil,and that is all that they think about.
But I will call to God for help.The Lord will make me safe.
I will weep and cry to him,morning, noon and night.He will listen to what I say.
I have very many enemieswho attack me all the time.But God will rescue me and keep me safe.
God has always ruled everything as king.He will listen to me,and he will punish my enemies.They refuse to change their thoughts,and they do not respect God.
But my friend has turned against his own friends.He has not been a true friend,as he promised to be.
He speaks a message of peace,but he is really thinking about war.His words are easy to listen to,but they hurt like sharp knives.
Take your problems to the Lord.He will take care of you.He will never let his own people fall.

And as for wicked people,you, God, will send them to their graves.They will go down into the deep hole of deathwhile they are still young.That is what will happen to those cruel people,who kill and cheat others.But I will trust in you, God.

headings.text: A prayer when a friend turns against you
The psalm has three parts:
Verses 1-8: David says that his enemies have made him afraid.
Verses 9-14: David says that his friend has turned against him.
Verses 15-23: David prays that God will
punish
his enemies.

footnotes.text: The city is Jerusalem, where David lived.
See 1 Peter 5:7.

verses.text: God, please be kind to me, and help me,because people are fighting me.My enemies are attacking me every day.
They chase me all the time!Those proud people want to catch me,and there are many of them!
But when I am afraid,I will trust in you.
By God's help, I will praise his word.By God's help, I will trust in him.I will not be afraid.People can do nothing to hurt me!
All the time, they bring trouble on me.They are always thinking of ways to hurt me.
They hide and they watch me.They watch me wherever I go,and they hope to kill me.
God, they want to do wicked things,so punish them!Destroy these people,because you are angry with them.
Every time that I am upset,you know about it.Put all my tears in your bottle!Yes, write down every tear in your book.
When I call to you for help,my enemies will turn back.I know that God is with me.He will fight for me.
By God's help, I will praise his promise.Yes, by the Lord's help,I will praise his word.
I am not afraid,because I trust in God.People can do nothing to hurt me.
I have made special promises to you, God,and I will do what I have promised.I will offer to you a sacrifice to say ‘thank you’.
You have saved my life from death.You keep me safe so that I do not fall.As a result, I will serve you, God,as you give me light to live here on earth.

headings.text: Trust in God and do not be afraid

Saul was trying to kill David, his servant. David ran away to Gath, the Philistine town where Goliath had lived. The Philistines were enemies of God's people, so David was afraid. He told God about it in this psalm. See

footnotes.text: Every time David cried, he knew that God understood all about his troubles.

verses.text: God, please be kind to me and help me!Please help me!I have come to you to keep me safe.Until the danger has gone, keep me near to you,as birds protect their babies under their wings.
I will call to the Most High God to help me.He is the God who stands beside me.
He will send help from heavenand he will save me.He will punish the people who attack me.God will show me his faithful love,and he will do what he has promised.

My enemies are all around me,like hungry lions!I must lie down among wild animalsthat want to eat me!They are men who use spears and arrowsto bite like teeth.They use their tongues to hurt people,like sharp swords.
God, show how great you are,high above the sky!Let everybody on the earth see your glory!
My enemies have prepared a trap to catch me.That makes me very upset.They have dug a deep hole on the path where I walk.But they have fallen into it themselves!
God, I have decided to trust you always.Yes, I will trust you!I will sing songs to praise you!
I will wake up now!I will pick up my harp and my lyre.I will make music as the sun rises!
My Lord God, I will thank youin front of all the people.I will sing to praise you,so that all nations hear.
Your faithful love is great.It is higher than the skies.Your truth reaches beyond the clouds.
God, show how great you are,high above the sky!Let everybody on the earth see your glory!

headings.text: Trust God in times of trouble

footnotes.text: We can read two places in the Bible when David hid in a cave. See 1 Samuel 22 and 1 Samuel 24.
David wants to make music to praise God. He will wake up early in the morning, so that he is already praising God at dawn.

verses.text: Do you rulers really say what is right?Do you judge people in a fair way?
No! You do not!You like to think of evil things to do.You make cruel things happeneverywhere in the land.
Wicked people do wrong things from their birth.As soon as they are born,they start telling lies.
Their words hurt peoplelike a snake's poison.They listen to nobody,like a deaf cobra.
It does not obey the voice of the magician,even if he sings very well!
God, break the teeth of my enemies!Yes, Lord, break into piecesthe teeth of those lions!
Cause them to run away like water and disappear.Cause them to die like dry grass in hot weather.
Cause them to be like a worm that melts as it moves along.Cause them to be like a child that is born deadand never sees the light of day.
Remove them quickly,more quickly than pots become hot over a fire of thorn bushes.
When God punishes those wicked people, righteous people will be very happy.They will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked people!
People who see it will say,‘It is true! God helps good people!There is a God who judges people on earth in a fair way.’

headings.text: God judges all people in a fair way
In this psalm, David asks God to
punish
his enemies. He knows that God always does what is right. God is the one who
judges
everybody in a fair way. The
Hebrew
in some of the verses is very hard to understand.

footnotes.text: A cobra is a dangerous snake. It has a poison that can kill people.
These wicked people will not listen to God. Some magicians can make snakes obey them when they sing or make music. The wicked people are like snakes that are deaf and they do not obey anyone.
David asks God to punish these bad people. David wants God to remove them very quickly. He used pictures of different things to say what he means.

verses.text: My God, please save me from my enemies!They are attacking me,so please keep me safe from them.
Rescue me from those dangerous men,who are doing evil things.
Look at them! They are waiting to kill me! Cruel men are ready to attack me. Lord, I have not done anything against them,but they still want to kill me.
I have done nothing that is wrong,but they are preparing to attack me.Do something to help me!Look at what they are doing!
For you are the Lord God Almighty,the God that Israel serves.Get up and punish all the foreign nations.Do not forgive any wicked peoplewho have turned against us.
Those wicked people come back to the city every evening.They go from place to place,and they cry out like dogs.
They shout evil things,and their words hurt like swords.They think, ‘Nobody can hear what we say!’
But Lord, you laugh at them.You laugh at all the foreign nations.
I will wait for you to help me,because you are the one who gives me strength.You, God, are the strong placewhere I will be safe.
Yes God, you love me with a faithful love,and you will come to help me.God will let me see that he has won against my enemies.
Do not kill them yet,or my people will soon forget.Use your power to send them away without homes.Then make them fall!You are our Lord God,who keeps us safe like a soldier's shield.
Those wicked people speak evil words.Let their own pride catch them in a trap,because they curse people,and they tell lies.
Because you are angry with them,destroy them!Destroy them completely,so that they are no more.Then everybody will know that God rules in Israel,and he rules everywhere in the earth.
Those wicked people come back to the city every evening.They go from place to place,and they cry out like dogs.
They go from place to placeand they look for food to eat.They will not rest until they are full.

But I will sing to praise you.I will sing about your strength!In the morning, I will praise youfor your faithful love.Because you are the strong place where I can hide.When I am in trouble,you keep me safe.
You are the one who gives me strength.I will sing songs to praise you.You, God, are my strong, safe place.You are the God who loves me with a faithful love.

headings.text: God is a strong, safe place for his people
See

footnotes.text: 1 Samuel 19:8-18

verses.text: God, you have turned against us,and you have broken down our strong walls. You are angry with us,but please make us strong again!
You made the ground shakeand you tore it open.Now mend the holes,or everything will fall down.
You have given your people a time of great trouble.You have given us strong wine to drink,that has made us fall like drunk people.
But you have lifted up a flagfor the people who serve you.They can meet together there,to be safe in the battle.
Use your power to rescue us!Answer our prayers!Then the people that you love will be safe.
God has spoken from his holy place! He has promised:‘I will show my power!I will divide Shechem into separate pieces.I will measure Succoth Valley.
Gilead belongs to me,and so does Manasseh.Ephraim is like my helmet for war.Judah has the authority of my royal sceptre.
But Moab is the place where I wash my hands.Edom is my servant.I can throw my shoes at him!I will shout loudly,because I have won against the Philistines.’
Who will lead me into the strong city?Who will take me to fight and win against Edom?
God, have you really turned against us?Will you not lead our armies into battle?
Help us to fight against our enemies,because help from men is useless!
With God's help, we will win!He will beat down our enemies for us.

headings.text: God has promised to help his people

footnotes.text: See 2 Samuel 8:3-13; 10:16-18; 1 Chronicles 18:3-12; 19:6-19. David was fighting a war. He was a long way from home, near the Euphrates River. After the war, when David was returning home, Edom's army attacked Jerusalem. David sent Joab, the leader of his soldiers, to fight against the Edomites. David's army beat them and killed 12,000 of them. This happened in Salt Valley, near the Dead Sea. David wrote the psalm because he thought that God had left him and his people. Edom was a country near Israel. It was also called Seir.
Edom's army broke down the city walls, but David decided that God had sent them to do it.
Strong wine that causes people to become drunk is often a picture of God's anger.
The holy place is God's home. Perhaps it was the temple in Jerusalem, or God's home in heaven.
Gilead, Manasseh, Ephraim and Judah were all parts of Israel. God will decide how to use them to serve him in important ways. Manasseh, Ephraim and Judah were Israelite tribes.
Moab, Edom and the Philistines were all enemies of Israel. God will use them in any way that he wants.
King David is the speaker again from verse 9 to verse 12.

verses.text: God, please hear me when I call to you for help.Listen carefully to my prayer.
I will call out to you from far away,because I am sad and weak.Lead me to a strong, safe rockthat is higher than I am.
You are the safe place where I can hide.You are like a strong towerthat keeps me safe against my enemies.
I want to live in your house for ever.I want you to keep me safe,as birds protect their babies under their wings.
You, God, have heard my promises to you.You have blessed me,as you bless all those people who serve you.
Please give the king a long life.Let him live to see many descendants.
Let him rule for everwith your authority.Cause your faithful love and your truth to keep him safe.
Then I will always praise your name.Every day I will give you the offerings that I have promised.

headings.text: A prayer for God to keep me safe

David was far away from Jerusalem, his home. He was probably fighting his enemies. Sometimes he was sad and afraid. He did not feel brave enough to fight, but he asked God for help. God was like a strong rock where David could hide and be safe.

footnotes.text: Cities often had walls around them. The walls had tall towers. The soldiers could see their enemies from the towers, but their enemies could not attack them there.

verses.text: I will be patient as I wait for God to help me.He is the only one who can make me safe.
He alone is the strong rockwhere I can hide and be safe.With him, nothing will make me fall.
How long will you all continue to attack me?I am just one man,and you want to kill me!You want to knock me down,like a weak wall or a fence that is falling down.
You only want to push me off my high place.You love to tell lies to deceive people.When you say words to bless people,you are cursing them in your thoughts.
I must be patient as I wait for God to help me.He is the only one that I can trust for help.
He alone is the strong rockwhere I can hide and be safe.With him, nothing will make me fall.
It is God who has kept me safe,and he has made me great.He is the strong place where I can hide and be safe.
Yes, my friends,you should always trust in God!Tell him about all the troubles in your thoughts.God is our safe place to hide!
People are only as light as a breath!Whoever they are, they are not important.If you try to weigh them, all together,they weigh less than a breath of air.
Do not cheat people,or rob them to get money!That will not give you anythingthat you can trust to help you.Even if you become very rich,do not think it is important.
I have heard God speak his truthonce, no twice!God has great strength.
And also, my Lord God, you have a faithful love.You pay back to everybody what they deservefor the things that they have done.

headings.text: Be patient as you wait for God to help

footnotes.text: A fence is a wall made of wood, not stones.

verses.text: God, you are my God.I want to be near to you.I need you to give me life,like a thirsty person in a dry desert.As a person needs water to live,that is how I need you.
When I have gone into your temple,I have seen what you are like.I have seen your great power and your glory.
Your faithful love for me is better than life itself.So I will speak aloud to praise you.
Yes, I will thank you for as long as I live.I will lift up my hands and I will pray to you.
You make me very happy,better than a feast of good food.I will sing happy songs to praise you.
When I lie on my bed,I think about you all through the night.
You are the one who keeps me safe,as a bird protects its babies under its wings.So I sing happy songs.
I keep very near to youand your strong right hand keeps me safe.
My enemies are trying to kill me,but I know that they themselves will die.They will go down into the deep hole of death.
Soldiers will kill them with swords.Wild dogs will eat their dead bodies.
But the king will sing songs to praise God. Everybody who promises to serve Godwill speak aloud to praise him.But everyone who tells lieswill not be able to say anything!

headings.text: God's love is better than life
See
. David was far away from the
temple
in Jerusalem. He wanted to know that God was still near to him.

footnotes.text: Judah was the land that belonged to Judah's tribe. It became the name for the Israelite kingdom in the south.
1 Samuel 23–24; 2 Samuel 15:23
David is probably talking about himself here, as king.

verses.text: God, please listen to meas I tell you about my troubles.Keep me safe from my enemieswhen they attack me.
When evil men think of ways to hurt me,hide me in a safe place.Those people work together as a groupto do wicked things.
Their tongues are likesharp swords that hurt people.Their cruel words are like arrows that they shoot at people.
They hide in secret places,and they quickly shoot lies at good people.They are not afraid that anyone will punish them.
They help each other to do evil things.They decide where they will hide their traps,and they say, ‘Nobody will see them!’
They think of wicked ideas to hurt people.They say, ‘That is a great idea!’Nobody really understands what people thinkdeep inside themselves.
But God will punish them!He will suddenly shoot an arrow at themand it will hurt them a lot.
Their own evil words will turn against themand make them fall.Everyone who sees them will shake their heads.
People will be afraid.They will say, ‘Look at what God has done!’They will think carefully about it all.
But people who serve the Lord should be happybecause of what he has done.They should trust him to keep them safe.Good, honest people should praise God,because he is great!

headings.text: God keeps his people safe
David wants God to keep him safe from bad people who wanted to hurt him. At the end of the psalm he says that people who
trust
God do not need to be afraid.

footnotes.text: Arrows are a picture of how God will punish them. The things that bad people do to hurt other people are like arrows. So God's punishment will also be like arrows.

verses.text: God, it is right for us to praise you in Zion.There, we will offer to youthe gifts that we have promised.
You answer our prayers.All of us must come to you,
because of our many sins.Our sins are too heavy for us to carry,but you forgive the bad things that we do against you.
You have blessed each person that you have chosen.You let them live near to you in your home.The good things that are in your holy templewill make us very happy!
God, you are the one who saves us!You answer our prayers,and you do great things to rescue us.People from everywhere on earth trust in you,even those who live far away across the seas.
You used your power to make the mountains,and you showed how strong you are.
You stop the seas from being angry,so that their waters make no noise.You do the same with the angry nations.
People who live far away seethe great things that you have done.It makes them afraid.Everywhere on earth, east and west,people sing happy songs to praise you.
You take care of the land.You send rain to make the earth good for plants.Your rivers are full of water.You cause the earth to give good cropsso that the people have grain to eat.
When people plough their fields,you send rain to make the earth wet.You make the ground soft with the rain,so that crops grow there.
Every year at harvest time,you bless people with lots of good things.Everywhere that you go,there is plenty of food.
Fresh grass covers the fields in the wilderness.There are plenty of good things all over the hills,so that people are very happy.
The fields are full of sheep.The valleys are covered with crops.Everywhere seems to shout and sing for joy!

headings.text: We praise God because he blesses us
We may call this a
harvest
psalm, to say ‘thank you’ to God for the food that he has given us.

footnotes.text: David says that the harvest is the best time of the year. The food that we have all comes from God.

verses.text: Everyone on earth, shout aloud to praise God,because you are very happy.
Sing to praise his great name!Praise him in the way that he deserves.
Say to God, ‘You do great things!Your great power makes your enemies afraid.They come to you and they bend down to the ground.
The whole world bends down to worship you.Everyone sings to praise your name.’
Come and see the great things that God has done.He has done wonderful miracles for people!
He caused the Red Sea to become dry land.His people walked across the river! We praise him for what he did there!
He has the power to rule for ever.He watches everything that the nations do. Wicked people should not be proud and turn against him.
You people from every nation,agree that our God is great!Praise him with loud voices,so that everyone can hear!
He keeps our lives safe.He does not let us fall to the ground.
You have tested us, God.You wanted to make us pure,as people make silver pure in a hot fire.
You caused a trap to catch us,so that we suffered very much.
You gave people power to hurt us.We went through dangerous fire and water.But then you brought us into a safe, open place.
I will bring burnt offerings to your Temple.I will bring you the gifts that I promised.
When I was in trouble, I made those promises.I spoke them aloud.
I will offer you gifts of fat animals,to burn them as sacrifices.I will also burn sheep as offerings,and their smell will please you.I will also offer bulls and goats to you.
Come and listen,all you people who serve God.I will tell you about the things that God has done for me.
I called to him for help,then I praised him aloud!
If I had kept wicked things in my mind,the Lord God would not have listened to me.
But God did hear me.When I called to him,he listened to my prayer.
So I praise God, as he deserves.He has not refused to listen to me.He has continued to love me with his faithful love.

headings.text: Everyone should praise God
This psalm tells about the great things that God has done to help his people. As a result, his people should
praise
him as he
deserves

footnotes.text: The Red Sea was between Egypt and the desert. God led his people out of Egypt where they had been slaves. He took them safely through the Red Sea on dry land. The ‘river’ may mean the Jordan River. The Israelites walked across that river into Canaan, the land that God had promised to give to them.

verses.text: God, please be kind to us and bless us.Look at us with a smile on your face.
Then people on the earth will knowwhat pleases you.People from all nations will knowthat you have the power to save them.
May people everywhere praise you, God.Yes, may they all praise you!
May the nations be so happythat they sing aloud with joy!Because you are fair when you judge people,and you are a guide for all the nations of the world.
May people everywhere praise you, God.Yes, may they all praise you!
The land has given us a harvest of food,and God, our God, continues to bless us.
God, please bless us!Then all people everywhere will give you honour.

headings.text: People of all nations should praise God

verses.text: God will rise upand he will chase his enemies away!The people who hate himwill quickly run away from him!
God, blow them away,as wind blows smoke away.Destroy those wicked people,as wax melts near a fire!
But righteous people will be happy,when they come near to you.They will shout with joy,because they are so happy!
Sing songs to God!Sing to praise his name!He is the one who rides on the clouds,so praise him aloud!His name is the Lord!Shout with joy to worship him!
God is a father for those who have no father.He takes care of widows.He rules from his holy home.
God gives homes and a family to lonely people.He makes prisoners go freeso that they are happy.But people who turn against himhave to live in a hot, dry land.
God, you led your people out.You took them across the desert.
Then the ground shook,and rain poured down from the sky.You showed your power at Mount Sinai.You are the God who rules at Sinai. You are the God that Israel's people serve.
God, you caused much rain to fallon your people's land.You made it fresh againwhen it had become dry.
Your own people came to live in it.God, because you are kind,you gave many good things to poor people.
The Lord God gives a command!Very many women take his message to other places.
Kings with large armies quickly run away.Yes, they run away!The women at home share the valuable thingsthat the armies have left behind.
Even those who stayed to take care of the sheepfound valuable things,like a dove with silver wingsand bright gold feathers.
When the Almighty God chased away foreign kings,it was like snow that fell on Mount Zalmon.
Bashan is a very great mountain.It has many high rocks.
You high mountains, why are you jealouswhen you look at Mount Zion?That is the mountain where God has chosen to live.Yes, that is where the Lord will live for ever!
God has millions of chariots.The Lord God has come from Mount Sinaito his own holy place.
When you went up to the highest place,you took many prisoners with you.You received gifts from men,even from the men who had fought against you.Yes, the Lord God lives there!
Praise the Lord God, as he deserves!Every day he helps us with our troubles.He is the God who keeps us safe!
Our God is the God who rescues people.The Almighty Lord saves us from death.
He will knock down the heads of his enemies.He will destroy their skulls and their long hair,if they continue to turn against him.
The Lord God says,‘I will bring my enemies back from Bashan,even from deep down in the sea.
Then you can wash your feet in their blood.Your dogs can have as much as they want!’
God, you are my God and my King.People will see the great crowd that goes with you,as you go to your holy temple.
The singers will march in front.The musicians will follow them.Young women will be with themas they beat their tambourines.
They all sing,‘Praise God, all you crowd of people!All you people of Israel,praise the Lord!’
Benjamin, the smallest tribe, will lead them all.The leaders of Judah, with their big group, will follow.Then will come the leaders of Zebulun and Naphtali.
God has commanded that you should be strong.God, please show us again how strong you are,as you have used your strength to help us in past times.
As you live in your temple in Jerusalem,kings will bring gifts to you.

Speak against your enemies!Some are like wild animals that live in the reeds. Some are proud nations,like bulls among their young cows.They must be humble.They must offer gifts of valuable silver things to you.Chase away those nations that like to fight wars.
Egypt's leaders will come with gifts.People will come from Cushand they will agree to serve God.
All you kingdoms of the earth,sing to God!Yes, sing to praise the Lord God!
He is the one who rides in the sky,as he has done from the beginning of time.Listen! He shouts with a powerful voice.
Agree that God is very powerful!He is the King who rules over Israel.He shows his power in the skies.
God, how great you are,as you come from your holy temple!He is the God of Israel.He gives power to his people,and he makes them strong.Praise God as he deserves!

headings.text: God rescues his people from their enemies

footnotes.text: Mount Sinai was the place where God gave his special commands to Moses, for the Israelites to obey.
God sent rain to make his people's crops grow.
Benjamin, Judah, Zebulun and Naphtali were four of Israel's 12 tribes.

The wild animals that live in the reeds might be hippopotamuses or crocodiles. Crocodiles are animals with hard plates of skin and a long tail. It lives in rivers and it can also walk on the land. Crocodiles can be dangerous.
Cush was where Ethiopia and Sudan are today.

verses.text: Please rescue me, God,because the deep water has come up to my neck.
I will soon sink into deep mud.There is no safe place to put my feet.I am now in deep water,and the floods pour over me.
I have shouted so much for helpthat I am tired and weak.My mouth is so dry that it hurts.I have looked so long for help from you, my God,that my eyes have become weak.

Very many people hate me with no good reason.They are more than the number of hairs on my head!My enemies are too strong for me.They want to destroy me with their lies.They make me give back to themthings that I did not take from them!
You know, God, that I do foolish things.I cannot hide my sins from you.
My Lord, Almighty Lord, Israel's God,do not let anyone who trusts youbecome ashamed because of me.Do not let anyone who serves youbecome ashamed because of me.
Because I belong to you,people insult me.They make me feel ashamed.
I have become like a stranger to my brothers.I am like a foreigner to my family.
My love for your house burns inside me like a fire.Anybody who insults you,is also insulting me!
When I weep and I stop eating food,it causes people to insult me.
When I wear sackcloth to show that I am sad,people laugh at me.
The leaders at the city gate talk about me. People who are drunk make songsto sing about me.
But as for me, Lord,I continue to pray to you.Please answer me at the right time.Be kind to me, God,because of your faithful love.Save me, as you have promised to do.
Rescue me out of the mudand do not let me sink down into it.Save me from the people that hate me.Save me from the deep water.
Do not let the floods pour over me.Do not let the deep sea cause me to drown.Do not let me fall into the deep hole of death.
Please answer me, Lord,because your faithful love is great.Turn to hear me,because you are so very kind.
Do not turn away from me, your servant.I am in great trouble,so please answer me very soon.
Come very near to me,and make me safe.Rescue me from my enemies.
God, you know that people are insulting me.They laugh at meto make me feel ashamed.You can see what all my enemies are doing.
When they insult me,it makes me very upset.I feel helpless.I hoped that someone would be kind and help me,but there was nobody.I wanted someone to comfort me,but I did not find anyone.
Instead, my enemies put poison in my food.When I was thirsty,they gave me vinegar to drink.
Please God, cause their feasts to become a trap for them.Let it bring trouble to them and their friends.
Let their eyes be in the darkso that they cannot see.Let their bodies become weak.
Yes, punish them,because you are so angry with them!
Let their homes become empty,so that nobody lives in them any more.
Do this, because they chase afterthe people that you have already punished.They talk about the painof the people that you have hurt.
Make a note of all their sins.Do not ever forgive them,so that they are righteous.
Remove their names from the book of living people.Do not write their nameson the list of righteous people.
But I have pain in my bodyand trouble in my mind.God, rescue me and keep me safe!
I will sing to praise God's name!I will thank him because he is great!
That will please the Lord morethan if I offer him an ox,or a great bull with horns.
When humble people see that God has rescued me,they will be very happy.People who want to serve Godwill become strong in their lives.
For the Lord listens to the prayers of poor people.He does not forget to help his peoplewhen they are prisoners.
Heaven and earth should praise him!The seas and everything that lives in themshould praise him!
For God will rescue Zion's people.He will build Judah's cities again. Then his people will live there.The land will belong to them again.
Then the descendants of his servantswill have the land for themselves.The people who love Godwill live there safely.

headings.text: Trust God for help

footnotes.text: The leaders of the people sat by the gate of their town. They talked together to decide what to do.
Vinegar has a bitter taste. It would not help someone who was thirsty.
Judah was the land that belonged to Judah's tribe. It became the name for the Israelite kingdom in the south. Zion's people were God's people who lived in Jerusalem.

verses.text: God, please save me! Lord, come quickly to help me!
Stop the people who want to kill me,so that they become ashamed and confused. Chase the people who want to hurt me,so that they run away in shame.
When people laugh at me,make them ashamed for what they have done.
God, may those who want to know you be very happy.Everyone who loves you because you have saved themshould never stop saying, ‘Praise God.’
But I am poor and weak, God.Please hurry to give me help.You are the one who helps meand who saves me. Lord, come quickly to help me!

headings.text: A prayer for God to help quickly
This psalm is the same as
. Also see

verses.text: Lord, I have come to you to keep me safe.Never let me become ashamed.
You always do what is right,so please rescue me!Listen to me, and come to save me!
Be a rock where I can hide.Be a strong place where I can be safe.You are my high rock and my strong, safe place.
My God, save me from the power of wicked people,so that those cruel people cannot catch me.
My Lord God, I trust you to help me.I have trusted in you, Lord,since I was young.
Since I was born,you have been there to help me.You have taken care of mesince my mother gave birth to me.So I will always praise you!
When people see me,they see trouble!But you are a strong place to keep me safe.
I can never stop praising you!All the time, I speak about your glory!
Do not chase me away when I am old.When I am no longer strong,do not turn away from me.
For my enemies say things against me.They think of ways that they can kill me.
They say, ‘God has turned away from him.Run after him and catch him,for nobody will rescue him.’
God, do not stay far away from me.My God, come quickly to help me!
Make my enemies become completely ashamed.They speak against me and they want to hurt me.So let them fall with great shame!
But as for me, I will always wait for you to help me.I will continue to praise you more and more.
I will tell people that you always do what is right.I will always speak about your power to save people.But you have done more than I will ever know about!
I will tell about the great things that you have done, Almighty Lord.I will tell everyone that you are righteous.You, only you, are righteous.
God, you have taught me since I was young.I still tell people about the great things that you have done.
And even when I am old and my hair is grey,do not turn away from me, God.I need to tell the people still to be bornabout your great strength.My descendants need to know about your power.
Your justice reaches beyond the sky above!You have done such great things, God.There is nobody like you!
You have caused me to have many bad troubles.But you will make my life strong again.You will lift me back outfrom this deep hole in the earth.
You will make me great again,so that people respect me.You will turn back to me,so that I feel strong.
I will pick up my harpand I will sing to thank you.I will praise you, my God,because you do what you promise.I will sing to praise you, the Holy One of Israel,with the music of a lyre.
I will shout aloud with joy,as I praise you with music!I will sing songs to praise you,because you have rescued me.
I will talk about your justice all the time.The people who want to hurt mewill become confused and ashamed.

headings.text: A song for old age

footnotes.text: The ‘Holy One of Israel’ is a name for God. He is the God that the Israelites worshipped.

verses.text: God, please help the kingto judge people in a right way.Help the king's son to be honest and fair,as you are.
Then he will rule your people in a good way,so that even poor people receive justice.
The mountains and the hills will bring peace,so that the people can live honest lives.
Please help the king to judge poor people fairly.May he save the children of weak people,and destroy those cruel people who hurt them.
May people always respect your authority, God,through all time,as long as the sun and the moon remain in the sky.
May the king be a blessing to his people,like rain that falls on grass that lies in the fields.May he be like rainthat brings water to the soil.
While he rules as king,those people who serve God will have success.There will be peace in all the land,for as long as the moon remains in the sky.
May the king rule everywhere,from sea to sea,and from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
Then people who live in the desertwill bend down to respect him.His enemies will fall downwith their faces in the dust.
Kings from Spain and from other far placeswill pay taxes to him.Kings from Sheba and from Sebawill bring gifts to him.
All kings will bend down in front of him.People from all nations will serve him.
He will rescue the poor personwho calls out to him for help.He will save weak peoplewho have nobody to help them.
He will be kind to people who are poor and weak.He will save them from death.
He will rescue them from cruel people who hurt them.Their lives are important to him.
Long live the king!May people come from Sheba to give gold to him.May people always pray for him.May people praise him all the time.

May there always be plenty of grainthat grows in the land.May the crops grow wellon the tops of the mountains.May the fruit trees give a lot of fruit,as they do in Lebanon.May all the crops grow well,like grass that grows in a field.

May the king be famous for ever!May people remember himfor as long as the sun continues to shine.May people from all nations use his namewhen they bless one another.May they all say that God has blessed the king!
Praise the Lord, Israel's God,as he deserves.Only he does such wonderful things.
Praise his great name for ever!May his glory fill the whole earth! Amen! May that all happen!
This is the end of the prayers of Jesse's son, David.

headings.text: A prayer for Israel's king
This psalm may be a
prayer
for David's son, Solomon. Some of the prayers only become true when David's
descendant
, Jesus Christ, appears as the great King.

footnotes.text: The king is also the son of a king, as he belongs to a royal family.
Or ‘May the king live through all time.’
The king will be so great that he will rule all the world. See Zechariah 9:10.
Psalm 72 finishes the Second Book of Psalms.

verses.text: God is truly good to the people of Israel,to people who want to serve him honestly.
But this is what happened to me:I nearly slipped and fell over.I could no longer stand properly.
When I saw that wicked people had plenty of things,I was jealous of those proud people.
Their bodies are fat and strong,and they feel no pain in their lives.
They do not have trouble like other people.They seem to have no problems.
Their pride is like their necklace.They like to be cruel,as they like to wear clothes.
Their greedy eyes lead them into sin.Their minds think of evil things to do.
They laugh at peopleand they say bad things about them.They proudly speak about cruel thingsthat they want to do to people.
They think that they rule in heaven,as well as on the earth!
As a result, God's people become confused,and they listen to them.They think that everything is truethat those wicked people say.
They say, ‘Does God really know what we do?Does the Most High God know everything?’
Take a good look,and see how wicked those people are!They have no troubles,and they become richer and richer.
I decided that I had tried to do what is right,but it did not help me at all!I had refused to do anything wrong,for no good reason!
I had trouble each and every day. Punishment came to me every morning!
If I had spoken aloud things like that,I would have turned against your own people.
When I thought about all this,it was so hard for me to understand.
But I went into your temple, God.Then I understood what would happento wicked people in the end.
Yes, I realized that they are in a dangerous place,where they will easily slip.You will cause them to fall down to their death.
It will take just a moment to destroy them!Great fear will sweep them away!
They will completely disappear,like a dream disappears after you wake up. Lord God, when you decide to do something,you will think that they are nothing!
I was very upset,and my thoughts were confused.
I was stupid,and I did not understand you properly.I was no better than an animal.
But I am always near to you.You hold my right hand,as my guide.
You teach me the right way to go.Finally, you will receive me with honour.
You are the only one in heaven or on earththat I need to help me.You are the only one that I want.
My body and my mind may become weak,but God will always keep me safe and strong.
Those people who stay far away from you will die.You destroy everybody who turns away from you.
But as for me, it is good for me to stay near to God.I have gone to the Almighty Lordas the place where I can be safe.I will tell people about the great things that you have done.

headings.text: God always does what is right
The writer saw that bad people often had success and
riches

. He could not understand why God allowed this to happen. Then he went into God's house. There he understood that bad people were not really in a good, safe place, as it seemed. God takes care of his own people, even when they have problems.

footnotes.text: This is the first psalm in Book 3 of the psalms.

verses.text: God, have you turned against us for ever?Why are you so angry with us?We belong to you, so please take care of us,like a shepherd takes care of his sheep.

Remember that we are your people.Long ago you chose us for yourself.You rescued us from being slaves,so that we could be your special nation of people. So please think about us,as well as your home on Mount Zion.
Come and look at our buildings!Your enemies have completely destroyed them.They have also destroyed everything that is in your temple.
Your enemies shout loudlyinside your special meeting place.They have put up their own flags there.
They used axes to cut the temple into pieces,like people who cut down trees!
They used their hammers and axesto break the beautiful wooden boards.
They completely burned your temple.They knocked it down to the ground!They caused your special place to become useless!
They said to themselves,‘We will completely destroy them all.’So they burned down every place in the landwhere people meet to worship God.
We no longer see any signs that God is with us.There are no more prophets among us.Nobody can tell us how long this will continue.
God, how long will our enemies laugh at you?Will they insult your name for ever?
Why do you do nothing to help us?Use your power now to punish them!
God, you have been my king from the beginning.You have done great things to rescue usall over the earth.
You divided the sea into separate pieces,because you are so strong.You broke the heads of the monstersin the waters of the sea.
You broke the heads of Leviathan. You gave his body as foodfor the animals that live in the desert.
You caused springs and streams of water to appear,and you made large rivers become dry!
Days and nights both belong to you.You put the moon and the sun in their places.
You said where the land must be among the seas.You made both summer and winter.
Lord, think about your enemies.They are always laughing at you. Foolish people are insulting your name.
We, your people, are like your own special dove.Do not let wild animals destroy us!We are weak and helpless,so do not forget about us!
Remember what you have promised to do for us.There are dark places everywhere,where cruel people hide.
We are weak, and people want to hurt us.Do not let us become ashamed.Instead, let the poor, weak people praise your name!
Do something, God!Show everyone that you are good.Think how fools are laughing at you all the time.
Do not forget what your enemies are saying.They shout things against you all the time!

headings.text: A prayer for our nation in a time of trouble
In 586
BC
, the army of Babylon attacked Jerusalem and they destroyed God's
temple
. The writer of this psalm asks God why he has allowed his people to suffer in this way.

footnotes.text: Israel's people were slaves in Egypt and God rescued them.
Leviathan is the old name of a sea monster.

Verses 13-15 describe the power that God has over everything in the universe. He showed his power when he created the world and everything in it. He also showed his power when he rescued his people from Egypt. He led them across the Red Sea to escape from Egypt's army. When God broke the heads of the monsters in the water, that may describe how Egypt's soldiers drowned in the Red Sea. He gave his people food to eat in the desert. He made the Jordan River become dry for his people to go across into Canaan.
These verses describe the time when God made the universe. See Genesis 1:1-31.

verses.text: God, we thank you!Yes, we thank you!You are very near to us.People everywhere say what great things you have done.
God says,‘I choose the time when I will judge people,and I will be a fair judge.
When the earth shakes and the people in it are afraid,I will keep its foundations strong.’
I say to people who are proud,‘Do not be proud.’I say to wicked people,‘Do not boast about your power.
Do not boast against God.Do not speak with such proud words.’
Who has the power to judge people?Nobody from the east, or from the west,or from the desert can be judge.
God is the one who judges people.He decides who to bring downand who to lift up.

The Lord holds a cup of punishment in his hand. It is full of wine, with spices in it.The Lord pours out his anger from this cup.All the wicked people in the world will have to drink it.They will drink all of it, so that none remains.
But as for me, I will always thank you, God.I will sing to praise you,the God of Jacob.
You say, ‘I will destroy the power of wicked people.I will give strength to my righteous people.’

headings.text: God judges people fairly

footnotes.text: God says that one person is wrong (he brings them down) and another person is right (he lifts them up).
A cup with strong wine in it is a picture of God's anger and punishment.

verses.text: People in Judah know who God is.He is famous in Israel.
His home is in Salem.Yes, he lives in Zion.
There he destroyed all the weapons of our enemy,their arrows, their shields,and their swords.He destroyed everything that they use to fight wars.
God, you are the one who shines with glory!You are greater than the greatest mountains.
You won against brave soldiers,so that we robbed them of everything.Now they are sleeping,and they will never wake up!They are completely helpless.
God of Jacob, when your enemies heard you shout at them,both the horses and their riders fell down dead.
Yes, everyone is afraid of you, our God!When you are angry,nobody can stand against you.
From heaven you said how you would judge people.Everybody on earth became afraid.They could not say anything!
This happened when you came to punish wicked people.You came to rescue the weak and poor people in the land.
Everybody will praise you,even those who are angry against you.You will show them how angry you really are.
Make promises to the Lord your God,and do what you have promised.Everyone who serves God should bring gifts to him.We must respect him with fear.
He makes proud rulers become humble.All the kings of the world should be afraid of him.

headings.text: God wins against his enemies

footnotes.text: Judah was one of Israel's tribes and the name for the Israelite kingdom in the south. The kingdom in the north was called Israel. Here, they are both names for God's people.
Salem and Zion are names for Jerusalem.

verses.text: I will call out to God for help.I will call aloud to God,and he will listen to me.
When trouble came to me,I looked for the Lord to help me.All through the night,I lifted my hands to him while I prayed.But I did not feel peace in myself.
When I think about God,I am sad and upset.I do not know if he will help me.
God, you do not let me close my eyes to sleep.I am so upset that I cannot even speak.
I think about my life long ago,in the years that have passed.
At night, I remember the songs that I sang before.I think carefully about what is happening.
I ask myself, ‘Will the Lord God always turn against me?Will he never be kind to me again?
Does he no longer have a faithful love for his people?Will he never do what he has promised us?
Has God forgotten to be kind and help us?Is he so angry that he will not be kind to us any more?’
Then I said, ‘This makes me very upset!Has the Most High God stopped helping us?
I will remember the things that the Lord has done.Yes, I will remember the miracles that you did long ago.
I will think about everything that you have done.I will think carefully about all those great things.’
God, your ways are holy.There is no god as great as our God.
You are the God who does miracles.You show the nationsthat you are very powerful.
You used your power to rescue your people.Yes, you saved the descendantsof Jacob and Joseph.
The waters of the sea saw you, God.When they saw you,they shook with fear!Even the deepest seas were afraid.
Rain poured down from the clouds.The noise of thunder was in the skies.Your arrows of lightningshot everywhere.
The sound of your thunder was in the storm.Your lightning made all the world bright.The earth shook.
You went through the sea.Your path went through the deep water,but nobody saw where your feet had gone.
You led your people,as a shepherd leads his sheep.Moses and Aaron did that for you.

headings.text: Remember how God has helped in times of trouble

footnotes.text: There are 6 questions which the writer asks. They mean, ‘Will God ever help us again?’
In verses 10-15, the writer remembers the great things that God has done. He remembers that God is still great and powerful.

Verses 16-20 are about God leading his people from Egypt to their new home in Canaan. God made a dry path through the Red Sea for his people. After they went across the Red Sea, Moses and Aaron led them through the wilderness.
Moses was a great leader of the Israelites, who gave God's laws to the people.

verses.text: My people, listen to what I am teaching you.Listen to the words that I speak.
I will tell you something to make you wise.Then you will understandthings that happened long ago.
We have heard about these thingsand we know them.Our ancestors have told them to us,

and we will not hide them from our children.We will tell our children and our grandchildrenwhy they should praise the Lord.We will tell them about his strength,and about the great things that he has done.
He gave his laws to Jacob's descendants,the Israelite people.He commanded our ancestorsto teach them to their children.
Then the children would know about them,even the children still to be born.When the time came,they too would tell their children.
Then their family would trust in God.They would not forget what God had done.They would obey his commands.
So they would not be like their ancestors,who turned against God.Those people refused to obey God,and they did not trust him to be their guide.
The soldiers of Ephraim had bows and arrows,but they ran away when the battle started!
They did not obey the covenantthat God had made with them.They refused to obey his laws.
They forgot about what he had done for them.They forgot the miracles that he had shown them.
He did miracles for their ancestors to see,in the region of Egypt that is called Zoan.
He divided the sea into two separate parts,and he led them through it.He made a path between two walls of water.
He showed them the way with a cloud in the dayand with light from a fire all night.
He broke rocks into pieces in the wildernessso that his people had plenty of water. Springs of water came from deep in the earth.
He caused streams to pour from the rocksso that the waters ran like rivers.
But his people continued to do bad things against him.In the wilderness,they turned against the Most High God.
They decided to test God,to see what he would do.They demanded to have the food that they liked best.
They spoke against God, and they said,‘Can God give us food to eat here in the wilderness?
Yes, water did come out when he hit the rock.The water poured out like a river.But can he also give us food to eat?Can he supply meat for his people?’
When the Lord heard this,he was very angry.So he sent fire to punish his people.He became very angry against the Israelites.
They did not trust God,that he had the power to save them.
So God commanded the clouds high aboveto give food to his people.He caused the skies to open like a door.
He poured down manna like rain,so that they could eat grain that came from heaven.
In that way, people ate the special bread of angels!God gave them all the food that they could eat.
Then God caused a wind to blow from the east.He used his power to send a south wind too.
He caused meat to pour down on them,like dust from the sky.The birds covered all the groundlike sand on the shore of the sea.
God made the birds fall near the tentswhere his people were living.

They ate as much as they could eat.Yes, God gave them what they had demanded! But God became very angry with them,even before they had finished eating.While the food was still in their mouths,he killed the strongest men among them.Many of the best young Israelite men died.
Even when this happened,the people continued to do bad things.When God had done these miracles,they still did not trust him to help them.
So he made their lives finish quickly, like a breath.They became very afraid.
When God killed some of them,the other people turned to God.They were sorry and they prayed to him.
They remembered that Godwas their strong Rock.They remembered that the Most High Godwas their Redeemer.
But they deceived him with their words.What they said to him was lies.
They did not really trust him.They did not obey the covenantthat he had made with them.
But God was kind to them,and he forgave them for their sins.He did not destroy them.Many times he was patient,and he did not become angry with them.
He remembered that they were weak and human,like a wind that blows away and does not return.
When the Israelite people were in the wilderness,they often turned against God.That caused God to be very sad.
Many times they tested God, the Holy One of Israel,so that he was very upset.
They forgot about his great power,and how he rescued them from their enemies.
He did powerful miracles in Egypt,in the region of Zoan.
He caused the Egyptians' rivers to become blood,so that they could not drink water from them.
He sent large numbers of flies to bite them. He sent frogs that destroyed their land.
He caused locusts to eat their crops,and everything that grew in their fields.
He destroyed their vines with hail.He destroyed their fig trees with frost.
He sent hail to kill their cows.He sent lightning to kill their other animals.
He was so angry with them,that he sent terrible things to punish them.Great trouble came to them,like an army of his angels that bring death.
Nothing could stop his anger.He did not save them from death.He let bad diseases kill them.
He killed all the firstborn sons in Egypt.The strongest men of Ham's descendants died.
But God led his own people safely out of Egypt.He took them through the wilderness,like a shepherd leads his sheep.
They were safe with him as their guide,and they were not afraid.But their enemies drowned in the sea.
He brought his people to the edge of his holy land.It was land with the mountainthat he had taken with his power.
He chased away the nations that were living there.He gave to each tribe their own piece of land,so that Israel's tribes could live there.
But the Israelites continued to test the Most High God,and they turned against him.They did not obey his commands.
They turned away from him and they deceived him,as their ancestors had done.They were useless,like a bow that could not shoot straight!
The places where they worshipped their idolsmade God very angry.
God heard what they were doing,and he became very angry.He turned against the Israelite people.
He went away from his home at Shiloh,the tent where he lived among people.
He let Israel's enemies take away the Covenant Box,that showed his power and his glory.
He was so angry with his own people,he let their enemies kill them in battle.
Fire killed their young men in war.There was nobody for the young women to marry.
