verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!Servants of the Lord, praise him!Praise the name of the Lord!
Everyone should praise the name of the Lordnow and for ever!
The Lord deserves that people praise him,from where the sun rises in the east,to where it goes down in the west.
The Lord rules over all nations.His glory is great.It is higher than the heavens!
There is nobody like the Lord our God.He sits on his throne high above us.
He bends down to look below,at the sky and the earth.
He lifts poor people out of the dirt.He lifts up weak people from the ashes.
He gives them a seat with princes,the princes who rule his own people.
He gives children to the woman who cannot give birth.She becomes a happy mother in her home.Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: God helps weak people
The Jews call Psalms 113 to 118, ‘the Egyptian Hallel’. ‘Hallel’ is a
Hebrew
word that means ‘to
praise
’. Hallelujah means ‘
Praise
the
Lord
!’ Jews say these six psalms when they eat the
Passover
meal together. They remember how God brought the Israelite people out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.

verses.text: God led Israel's people out of Egypt.Jacob's descendants left that foreign land.
Judah became God's special place for his people.There he ruled over Israel's people.
The sea looked and ran away!The Jordan River also turned back!
The mountains shook,like sheep that are jumping.The hills jumped like lambs.
Tell me, sea, why did you run away?Tell me, Jordan River, why did you turn back?
And you mountains and hills,why did you jump like sheep?
Earth, shake with fear!The Lord, Jacob's God, has come to you,so be afraid!
He changed a rock into a pool of water!Water poured out of a hard rock!

headings.text: Remember the great things that God has done
This is the second ‘Hallel’ psalm. It tells us what happened when the people of Israel left Egypt.

footnotes.text: Judah was the land that belonged to the tribe Judah, one of the 12 tribes of Israel. It became the name for the Israelite kingdom in the south.

The sea was the Red Sea. The Israelites had to go across it to escape from Egypt. See Exodus 14:10-22 A dry path appeared in the sea so that they could go across. God also opened a way for them to go across the Jordan River into Canaan. See Joshua 3:7-17.
The hills and mountains jumped like animals when the Lord was near. See Exodus 19:18-20.
See Exodus 17:1-7; Numbers 20:11.

verses.text: Lord, you are the onewho deserves that people praise you.They should praise only you, not us!You love us with a faithful love,and you always do what you have promised.
Why should other nations say about us,‘Where is their God?’
We know that our God is in heaven.He does whatever he wants to do.
The idols of those nations are made of silver and gold.Yes, human hands have made them!
Each idol has a mouth, but it cannot speak!It has eyes, but it cannot see!
It has ears, but it cannot hear!It has a nose, but it cannot smell!
It has hands, but it cannot feel anything!It has feet, but it cannot walk!It cannot make a sound!
The people that make those idolswill become useless like them.The same is true for everyonewho trusts their idols to help them.
People of Israel,trust in the Lord.He is the one who helps youand keeps you safe.
Aaron's family,trust in the Lord. He is the one who helps youand who keeps you safe.
Everyone who gives honour to the Lord,trust in the Lord.He is the one who helps youand who keeps you safe.
The Lord will remember us,and he will bless us.He will bless Israel's people.He will bless Aaron's family.
He will bless everybody who serves him,whether they are important people or not.
I pray that the Lord will give you many children,and your children too!
I pray that the Lord will bless you all.He is the one who made the whole universe.
The heavens belong to the Lord,but he has given the earth to us people.
Dead people cannot praise the Lord.In their graves, they are unable to speak.
But we will praise the Lord,now and for ever. Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: There is only one true God
This psalm teaches us that there is only one God. He is the one that the Israelites should
trust
. Other gods are false and they have no power to help us.

footnotes.text: Aaron's family were the priests.

verses.text: I love the Lord,because he heard me when I called to him.
He listened carefully to me.I will always pray to him,for as long as I live.
The danger of death was very near to me.I was afraid of the deep hole of death.I was very sad and upset.
Then I called out to the Lord.I said, ‘Lord, please save my life!’
The Lord is kind and fair.Yes, our God is very kind.
The Lord takes care of helpless people.I was in danger of death,and he saved me!
So now I know that I am safe again.The Lord has been very good to me.
Yes, Lord, you saved me from death!My eyes no longer weep,and I do not fall down to the ground.
Now I will serve the Lordhere in this world where people live.
I trusted in the Lordeven when I said, ‘I have much pain.’
I was upset and I said,‘Everybody tells lies.’
The Lord has done many kind things to help me.What can I give back to him?
I will offer a cup of wine to the Lord,to thank him because he saved me!I will worship him.
I will give to the Lordeverything that I have promised.I will do that when all his people meet together.
The Lord is sad when one of his servants dies,because their lives are valuable to him.
Lord, I am truly your servant.I am like a slave in your house.You have saved me from death.
I will offer a sacrifice to youto say ‘thank you’.I will worship you as Lord.
I will give to the Lordeverything that I have promised.I will do that when all his people meet together,
in the yard of the Lord's temple.Yes, I will worship you in your temple in Jerusalem. Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God who saved me from death

This psalm is the fourth of the ‘Hallel’ psalms. This psalm is about one man's trouble. God saved him when he thought that he would die. He wants all the people to know that God has been very kind to him.

verses.text: You people of all nations, praise the Lord!People from every place,praise him!
The Lord's faithful love for us is very strong.He will always do what he has promised.Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God for his faithful love

verses.text: Thank the Lord, because he is good.His faithful love will always be with us.
Israel's people must now say,‘His faithful love will always be with us.’
Aaron's family, the priests, must now say,‘His faithful love will always be with us.’
Everyone who serves the Lord must now say,‘His faithful love will always be with us.’
I was very upset,so I called to the Lord to help me.The Lord answered me.He made me free from my trouble.
The Lord is here to help me,so I will not be afraid.Nobody can do anything to hurt me!
The Lord is with me as my helper.As for those people who hate me,they will fall down as I watch them.
It is better to go to the Lord to keep you safe,than to trust in people.
It is better to trust the Lord to keep you safe,than to trust leaders to protect you.
All the nations were ready to attack me.I used the Lord's authority to send them away.
Yes, they were all around me, ready to attack me.I used the Lord's authority to send them away.
They were all around me like a crowd of bees!But they soon disappeared,like a fire in a thorn bush.Yes, I used the Lord's authority to send them away.
My enemies attacked meand they tried to knock me down!But the Lord helped me.
The Lord makes me strongand he takes care of me.He is the one who keeps me safe.
Listen to the happy shouts of God's people in their tents!They have won against their enemies,because the Lord has power to do great things.
Yes, the Lord has lifted up his strong right hand.He has the strength to win the battle!
I will not die. Instead, I will live.I will tell everyone what the Lord has done.
The Lord has punished me very much,but he has not let me die.
Open the gates of the temple!I will go in there,and I will thank the Lord.
This is the Lord's gate. Righteous people can go in through it.
I will thank you, Lord,because you answered my prayer.You have rescued me.
The builders refused to use a certain stone.But now that stone has become the most important stoneat the corner of the building.
The Lord has done this,and we can see that it is wonderful!
This is the day that the Lord has done a great thing.We will be very happy today!
Lord, please save us now! Lord, please help us to have success!
May the Lord bless the man who comes with his authority! We praise you from here,in the house of the Lord.
The Lord is truly God.He has caused his light to shine on us.Enjoy a happy festival!Take branches in your hands,and offer a sacrifice on the altar.
You are my God,and I will thank you.You are my God,and I will say how great you are.
Thank the Lord, because he is good.His faithful love will always be with us.

headings.text: God is good, so thank him
The writer wants people join him and
praise
God together. He thanks God that he has given his people power to win against their enemies.

footnotes.text: See Matthew 21:42; Mark 12:10-11; Luke 20:17; Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7.

verses.text: People who always do what is right are truly happy.They obey the Law of the Lord.
They agree to live by his rules. They love to pray to him.God has blessed people like that.
They do nothing that is wrong.They live in a way that pleases the Lord.
You, Lord, have told us to obey your teaching carefully.
I want to be able to obey your laws all the time.
When I remember all your commands,I will not be ashamed.
When I learn your good rules,I will do what is right and I will thank you.
Yes, I will obey your laws.Please do not turn away from me!
How can a young man live a pure life?He must be careful to obey your message.
I bring all my thoughts to you.Do not let me turn away from your commands.
I always keep your message in my mind,so that I do not do anything bad against you.
Lord, everyone should praise you!Please teach me your laws.
You have taught us your rules.I will speak them aloud for others to hear.
Your rules give me a happy life.When I obey them,it is better than being rich!
I want to think carefully about your teaching.You have shown me the best way to live.
Your laws make me very happy.I will not forget what you have taught me.
Please be kind to me, your servant.Then I will live and I will obey your message.
Open my eyes wide!Then I will see great things in your Law.
I live like a stranger here on the earth.Please do not hide your commands from me.
I really want to obey your rules all the time.I want that more than anything else.
You warn people who are proud.If they turn away from your commands,you will surely punish them.
I obey your rules.So do not let people insult me,so that I become ashamed.
Rulers may think of ways to hurt me.But I will think carefully about your rules.
Yes, your laws make me really happy.They show me the right way to live.
I have fallen into the dust on the ground.I am almost dead.Give me life again,as you have promised to do.
I told you what my life is like,and you answered me.Please teach me your laws.
Help me to understand what your teaching means.Then I will think carefully about the great things that you do.
I am so sad that I feel very weak.Use your word to make me strong again.
Stop me from living in a wrong way.Please be kind to me,so that I know your Law.
I have chosen to live in the right way.I will continue to obey your rules.
Yes, Lord, I will always respect your teaching.Please do not let me become ashamed.
I want to obey your commands all the time.Help me to understand them more and more.
Lord, help me to understand your teaching,then I will always obey it.
Explain your Law to me,so that I will obey it.I will always love to do what it says.
Help me to live in a way that respects your commands.That is what makes me very happy.
Help me to love your rules.That is better for me than riches.
Turn my eyes away from useless things.Use your word to help me to live.
I am your servant.Please do what you have promised to do.You have promised to bless anyone who respects you.
I am afraid when people insult me.Your rules are good,so do not let me be ashamed.
I really want to obey your rules.Because you are righteous,please let me continue to live.
Lord, I want your faithful love to be with me.Please keep me safe,as you have promised.
Then I will be able to answer the people who insult me.I will show them that I trust in your word.
Do not stop me from speaking your true word!I know that you will do what is right.
I will always obey your Law,now and for ever.
I will not be in danger as I live,because I try to obey your teaching.
I will speak to kings about your rules.I will not be ashamed to do that.
I love your commandsand they make me very happy.
I respect your commands,and I love them.I am always thinking about your laws.
Remember the word that you have spoken to me, your servant.You have helped me to hope in it.
When I have trouble,your promise gives me peace in my mind.It makes my life strong again.
Proud people laugh at me all the time.But I do not turn away from your Law.
Lord, I think about the rules that you made long ago.When I do that, I feel happy.
When wicked people turn against your Law,I become very angry.
Wherever I live,I sing songs about your rules.
In the night, Lord,I think about who you are.I will continue to obey your Law.
This is what I do every day:I obey your teaching.
Lord, you are everything that I need.I promise to obey your rules.
I ask you, ‘Please, please take care of me.Be kind and forgive me,as you have promised to do.’
I have thought about the way that I live.I promise to obey your teaching.
I will be careful to obey your commands.I will not be slow to do that.
Wicked people try to catch me in their traps,but I will not forget your Law.
I get up in the middle of the night to praise you.I thank you for your fair rules.
I am a friend of everyone who respects you,and who obeys your teaching.
Lord, your faithful love is everywhere!Please teach me your commands.
Lord, you have blessed me, your servant,as you have promised to do.
Teach me to understand what is right,because I trust your commands.
Before you showed me what was right,I made mistakes.But now I obey your teaching.
You are good and you do good things.So please teach me your laws.
Proud people have told many lies against me,but I love to obey your rules.
Those people do not understand anything,but your Law makes me very happy.
When I suffered,it was good for me.It helped me to learn your commands.
The rules that you have taught me are very valuable.They are more valuable to methan thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
You made me with your hands.You made me what I am.Help me to understand things well,so that I learn your commands.
People who respect you will be happy when they see me.That is because I trust your word.
Lord, I know that your rules are good and fair.When you sent trouble to me,it was because you truly loved me.
Now, please use your faithful loveto comfort me.That is what you promised to do for me, your servant.
Be kind to me so that I will live!Your Law makes me really happy.
Proud men should be ashamed!They have spoken lies against me.
Let the people who respect you join with me.They will learn to obey your rules.
Let me obey your commands completely.Then I will not be ashamed.
As I wait for you to save me,I feel tired and weak.I trust in your word.
As I wait for you to do what you have promised,my eyes are too tired to stay open.I ask, ‘When will you come to help me?’
I am like an old wineskin that has become useless.But I have not forgotten your rules.
As your servant, how much longer must I be patient?Please punish the people who want to hurt me.Please do it soon.
Proud people want to catch me in their traps.That is against your Law!
I know that I can trust all your commands,but people still give me trouble with their lies.Quickly, help me!
People here on earth have almost destroyed me,but I continue to obey your teaching.
Please use your faithful love to keep me alive.Then I can continue to obey the rules that you have taught me.
Lord, your teaching will always be there.You keep it safe in heaven.
You always show that people can trust you,from one century to the next.You have fixed the earth in its place,and it will remain.
It is by your command that all things continue.You have put everything there to serve you.
If your Law had not made me truly happy,I would have been sad until I died.
I will never forget your rules,because you have used them to give me life.
I belong to you. Please save me!I have respected your rules.
Wicked people are ready to kill me,but I think carefully about your laws.
I have learned that all things will come to an end,but your commands have no end.
I love your Law very much.I think about it all through each day.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies.They are always in my thoughts.
I understand more than all my teachers,because I think carefully about your rules.
I understand more than people who are old,because I obey your teaching.
I do not follow evil ways,so that I can obey your word.
I do not turn away from your rules,because you are my teacher.
Your words are very good.They taste sweeter than honey in my mouth!
Your teaching helps me to understand things,so I hate anything that is false.
Your word is like a lamp that shines as my guide.It shows me the right way to live.
I have made a strong promisethat I will always obey your righteous rules.
I am suffering very much. Lord, please keep me safe,as you have promised to do.
Lord, please accept the praisethat I choose to offer to you.Teach me your rules.
My life is always in danger,but I never forget your Law.
Wicked people try to catch me in a trap,but I do not turn away from your teaching.
Your laws will always be with me.They make me happy deep inside.
I have decided to obey your commands always,until the end of my life.
I hate people who are not faithful to you.I love your Law.
You are the safe place where I can hide.You keep me safe like a soldier's shield.I know that I can trust your word.
Go away from me, you evil people!I will obey my God's commands.
Help me to be strong, Lord,as your word promises.Do not let me be ashamed because of my hope.
Please help me so that I will be safe.Then I will always obey your commands.
You refuse people who turn away from your laws.You do not accept them,because they speak lies to deceive people.
The wicked people in the worldare like rubbish to you.So I choose to obey your rules.
I respect your great strength,so that my body shakes with fear.The laws that you use to judge peoplemake me afraid.
I have done what is fair and right.Do not leave me aloneso that my cruel enemies can hurt me.
Promise to take care of me, your servant.Do not let proud people hurt me.
I have been waiting a long time for you to save me.My eyes have become tired.I am waiting for you to save me,as you have promised to do.
Please be kind to me, your servant,so that I see your faithful love.Continue to teach me your laws.
I am your servant. Help me to be wise,so that I can understand your rules.
It is time for you to do something, Lord,because people have turned against your Law.
That is why I love your commands.They are more valuable to me than very pure gold.
So I carefully obey your teaching.I hate everything that is false.
Your laws are wonderful, Lord!So I obey them.
Your message brings light to people,when they understand it.It helps ordinary people to become wise.
I want to know your commands,like a thirsty dog needs water to drink.
Turn towards me and be kind to me,as you always do for those who serve you.
Use your word to lead me along the right way.Do not let sin rule over me.
Keep me safe from cruel people,so that I can obey your teaching.
Show a kind face to me, your servant.Teach me your laws.
I weep with streams of tears,because people do not obey your Law.
Lord, you are righteousand your laws are completely fair.
The rules that you have given us are good and right.We can trust them completely.
I am so angry that it makes me weak.My enemies do not accept your message.
I know that your promises are completely true.I love them very much.
I am not important enough for people to respect me,but I do not forget your teaching.
You will always do what is rightand your law is completely true.
I am suffering because of great trouble,but your commands make me happy.
Your rules are always fair.Help me to understand them,so that I may find true life.
With all that I am, I call to you,‘Answer me, Lord!I will obey your commands.’
I say to you, ‘Save me,so that I can obey your rules.’
I wake up before dawnand I cry to you for help.I trust what you have said.
I am awake during each night,and I think carefully about your message.
You love me with a faithful love,so please listen to me! Lord, do what is right,and keep my life safe.
People who want to do evil thingsare ready to attack me.They have no interest in your Law.
Lord, you are near to me,and I can trust all your commands.
I have studied your teaching since long ago.I know that you have made it to remain for ever.
Look at my pain and trouble!Please save me,because I do not forget your Law.
Stand beside me and protect me.Keep me safe,as you have promised to do.
Wicked people do not obey your rules,so their lives will never be safe.
Lord, you are very kind.Please do what is right,and keep my life safe!
I have many enemieswho are ready to hurt me.But I do not turn away from your rules.
When I see people who have turned against you,they make me very upset.They do not obey your commands.
See how I love your teaching, Lord!Please keep my life safe,because of your faithful love for your people.
I can trust that your message is true.All your righteous rules will continue for ever.
Rulers want to hurt me for no good reason.But it is your message that I respect with fear.
Your teaching makes me very happy.I am like someone who has found great riches.
I hate all kinds of lies,but I love your Law.
I praise you seven times each day,because of your righteous rules.
People who love your Law have peace in their minds.Nothing will cause them to fall down.
Lord, I trust you to save me,as I obey your commands.
I will continue to obey your rules,because I love them so much.
I obey your commands and your teaching,because you know everything that I do.
Listen to me, Lord,as I call to you for help!Help me to understand your word.
I ask you to be kind to me,so please listen!Keep me safe,as you have promised to do.
I will always speak aloud to praise you,because you teach me your rules.
I will sing about your message,because all your commands are righteous.
Please be ready to help me,because I choose to obey your teaching.
Lord, I am waiting for you to save me.Please do it soon!Your Law makes me very happy.
Keep my life safe,so that I can praise you.Use your laws to give me help.
I have left the right way,like a sheep that has become lost.Come to make me safe again,as a shepherd looks for his lost sheep.Help me, your servant,because I have not forgotten your commands.

footnotes.text: This psalm uses many different words to talk about God's message to us. We do not have the same words in English as the psalm has in the Hebrew language. The psalm talks about God's Law, his rules, his commands, his message, his teaching, his word and his promises. Every part of the psalm uses many of these different words. The different words help us to see that the Bible teaches us in many different ways.

verses.text: I cried to the Lord to help me in my trouble.He answered me.
I prayed, ‘Lord, keep me safe from people who tell lies.Save me from people who want to deceive me.’
How will God punish you,you people who deceive others?He will punish you as you deserve!
Yes, the sharp arrows of a soldier will hurt you.They will give you pain, like wood that burns with fire.
I am so sad! I live in Meshech as a stranger.I live among the people of Kedar.
I have lived too long with people who hate peace.
I want to live here in peace.But when I speak about peace,they only want war!

headings.text: God answers a prayer for help
Psalms 120–134 are called ‘Climbing Songs’. The Israelites probably sang them as they went towards God's
temple
in Jerusalem. The temple was high up on a hill. When people sang these songs, they were preparing to
worship
God in his temple.

verses.text: As I travel, I look up towards the hills.I will find no help there.
My help comes from the Lord.He made heaven and the earth.
He will take care of you,so that you do not fall.The one who protects you will not sleep.
Yes! The Lord keeps Israel's people safe.He never gets tired or sleeps at all!
The Lord is the one who keeps you safe.He is always with you,to give you shade from the hot sun.
The hot sun will not hurt you in the daytime.At night, the moon cannot hurt you.
The Lord is the one who takes care of you in all danger.He keeps your life safe.
Whatever you do and wherever you go,the Lord will always keep you safe,now and for ever.

headings.text: God keeps his people safe

footnotes.text: When the Israelites travelled to Jerusalem, they would go through dangerous places. There might be robbers in the hills.

verses.text: It made me very happy when people said to me,‘We will go to the house of the Lord.’
Now we have arrived!We are standing inside your gates, Jerusalem!
Jerusalem is a strong city where many people can meet together.
Israel's tribes who belong to the Lord go up there.They go there to thank the Lord,as he has commanded them.
Israel's rulers sit there to judge the people.They sit on the thrones of King David's descendants.
Pray that there will be peace in Jerusalem.Pray that people who love Jerusalem will be safe.
Yes, I pray that there will be peace inside the city's walls.I pray that people will be safe in their strong houses.
Because of my family and my friends I will pray,‘Please let there be peace in Jerusalem.’
Because of the house of the Lord our God,I will pray for good things to happen in Jerusalem.

headings.text: A prayer for peace in Jerusalem

footnotes.text: ‘The house of the Lord’ was a tent when King David was alive. Later, King Solomon built a temple to be God's house.

verses.text: I look up to you, God,as you rule from your throne in heaven.
Yes, our eyes look up to the Lord our God.We want him to be kind to us,so we wait for his help.We wait like servants who want help from their master.
Please be kind to us, Lord.Please forgive us.People have insulted us more and more!
We have had too much! Proud people laugh at us,and they do not respect us.Please stop them!

headings.text: A prayer for God to forgive his people

verses.text: If the Lord was not fighting for us,what would have happened?Israel's people, now answer:
‘If the Lord was not fighting for uswhen men attacked us,
our enemies would have eaten us alive! They would have destroyed us,because they were so angry against us.
They would have been too strong for us,like rivers of waters that covered us.
They would have been like deep water over our headsthat drowned us.
We should praise the Lord!He did not let our enemies destroy us,like wild animals that kill their food and eat it.
Now we have become free,like a bird that escaped from a trap.Our enemies lost their power, and we are free!
The one who helped us is the Lord.He is the one who made the whole universe.’

headings.text: God helps his people to win against enemies

footnotes.text: David may have written this psalm when he was fighting against the Philistines. The psalm says that if God had not helped his people, the enemy would have destroyed them.
‘Eaten us alive’ is a word picture that means ‘destroyed us’.
The rivers and deep water are pictures of the power of the enemy.
A trap is something to catch an animal or bird in. David felt that Israel was in a trap, but God made them free.

verses.text: People who trust in the Lord are strong,like Mount Zion. Nothing can shake it.It will always be there.
The Lord is always near to his people,like the mountains around Jerusalem.He keeps his people safe, now and for ever.
Wicked people will not rule over God's own people.They will not rule the land where righteous people live.If they did, the righteous people might also do bad things.
Lord, please do good things to good, honest people.Be kind to those who follow your good ways.
But as for people who follow their own bad ways, Lord, remove them!Take them away, together with people who do evil things.May Israel have peace!

headings.text: God takes care of his people

footnotes.text: Mount Zion was a strong place in the middle of the city of Jerusalem.

verses.text: When the Lord turned us around,so that we enjoyed a good life in Zion again,we thought that we were dreaming!
At that time, we laughed a lot.We sang with joy because we were so happy!People in other countries said to each other,‘The Lord has done great things for them!’
Yes, the Lord has done great things for us.So we are very happy.
Lord, please bless us as you did before.It will be like streams of water that return to the desert.
When people went to plant seeds in their fields,they were crying.But they will be happy when they bring in the harvest!
People were weeping when they took their bags of seeds to plant. But when they carry their crops back home,they will shout because they are so happy!

headings.text: God has done great things for his people!
The writer of psalm 126 remembers how God helped his people in past times. He wants to see God work in the same way again.

footnotes.text: The people had not been able to plant seeds in their fields for a long time. So now it was hard work to prepare the ground. They had to take their valuable seeds and plant them. So they had less food to eat until the harvest time. That is why they were sad.

verses.text: The Lord must build your house.If not, the work of the builders is useless.The Lord must keep the city safe.If not, the city guards are useless.
If you work all day for food, and never stop,it is also useless.God gives food to the people that he loves.Even while they sleep,God takes care of them.
Children are a gift from the Lord.He blesses us with descendants.
If you have sons while you are a young man,they are like a soldier's arrows that he can use.
If a man has many sons,he is truly happy.When his enemies speak against him at the city gate,they will not win.

headings.text: Every good thing comes from God
Psalm 127 tells us that only God can give us the good things that we need for life. He is the only one who can keep us safe.

footnotes.text: The city gate was the place where people met to decide their quarrels.

verses.text: If people respect the Lordand they obey his commands,they are truly happy!
You will eat the food that you have worked hard to grow.You will have everything that you need.You will be happy!
Your wife will be like a vine that grows in your home,and it gives many grapes.Your children will sit around your table,like the branches of an olive tree that are around you.
Yes, if a man respects the Lord,that is how God blesses him.
The Lord rules from Zion,and I pray that he will bless you. Then you will see that Jerusalem is a good place to live infor as long as you live.
I pray that you will live to see your grandchildren.May Israel have peace!

headings.text: God blesses families

footnotes.text: Both word pictures mean that you will have a happy family, with many children. An olive tree has many branches.
Solomon built God's house, the temple, on Mount Zion in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Since I was young, my enemies have often attacked me.Israel's people now answer:
‘They have often attacked me since I was young,but they have not won against me.
They hit my back with whips.They made long marks on it,like farmers who are ploughing their fields.
But the Lord is righteous.He has made me free from those cruel people.’
I pray that everyone who hates Zion's people will be ashamed.Then they will have to turn around and go back.
May they be useless, like grass that grows on a roof.It dies before it can grow tall!
A gardener cannot use it.A farmer will not keep it.
People who go past will not say to them,‘We will ask the Lord to bless you!’Nobody will say to those who hate Zion's people,‘Receive our blessing in the name of the Lord!’

headings.text: A prayer against cruel enemies

footnotes.text: The grass quickly dies because there is no earth on a roof. Because of that, there will be no fruit that the gardener or the farmer can use.

verses.text: Lord, I am crying aloud to youbecause I have great trouble.
My Lord God, please listen to me!I am asking you to be kind and help me.
Lord, if you should write down all our sins,nobody could stand as a righteous person.
But you forgive people for their sins,and so we give you honour.
I will wait for the Lord to help me.I trust him completely.So I wait for him to do what he has promised.
I want my Lord God to come and help me,more than a guard at night wants the morning to come.Yes, I want my Lord to come quickly,even more than that.
Israel's people, trust the Lord to help you.The Lord has faithful love for his people.He is always ready to save them.
He will save Israel's people from all their sins.

headings.text: Trust God in times of trouble

verses.text: Lord, I am not proud.I do not think that I am a great person.I do not try to do great things.I do not worry about things that are too hard for me to understand.
Instead, I am quietand there is peace in my mind.I am like a young child who sits on his mother's knee.Yes, I have peace in my mind.
Israel's people, trust the Lord to help you,now and for ever.

headings.text: Trust God and do not worry

verses.text: Lord, remember King Davidand all the troubles that he had.
He made a special promise to the Lord.He promised you, the Mighty One of Jacob.
He said, ‘I will not go into my house or get into my bed;
I will not sleep even for a moment,
until I find a house for the Lord.Yes, the Mighty One of Jacob needs a proper home.’
Listen! We heard the news at Ephrathah. We found God's Covenant Box in the fields of Jaar.
We will go to the Lord's home!We will worship him on his throne!
Lord, come now and stay here, in your home!Come with the Covenant Box that shows your great power.
May your priests serve you in a good way.Cause your faithful people to shout with joy!
Remember your servant, King David.Do not turn away from your chosen king.
The Lord made a strong promise to David.He will not change what he has promised to do.The Lord said,‘I will put one of your sons on your throne to rule as king.
If your sons obey my covenant and my rules,their descendants will rule for ever.’
The Lord has chosen Zion to be his home.
He said, ‘This is where I will live for ever.This is where I want my home to be.
I will give Zion's people everything that they need.Zion's poor people will have plenty of food to eat.
I will keep Zion's priests safe.The people who serve God faithfully will shout loudly,because they are so happy.
In Zion I will give strength to King David's family.My chosen king will continue to rule well,like a light that shines brightly.
I will cause his enemies to be ashamed.But his own kingdom will be great!’

headings.text: God chose Zion to be his home

footnotes.text: ‘The Mighty One of Jacob’ is another name for God, who ruled over the Israelites. The Israelites were descendants of Jacob.
David wanted God to have a proper home. He wanted to build a temple for the Lord. It was his son, Solomon, who built the temple after David died.
Ephrathah is another name for Bethlehem.
Jaar is another name for Kiriath-Jearim. See 1 Samuel 7:1-2; 1 Chronicles 13:5-6.
King David brought the Covenant Box to Jerusalem. He put it in a special tent. See 1 Chronicles 15:25-29; 16:1-6.
The word for ‘chosen king’ is ‘Messiah’ in the Hebrew language. Jesus was King David's great descendant who became king for ever.

verses.text: It is good for a family of God's people to live together in peace.Yes! It brings great pleasure!
It brings pleasure like valuable olive oilthat is poured on your head,and it goes down onto your beard.They poured it onto Aaron's head and his beard,and it went down onto his clothes.
It brings pleasure like the dew on Mount Hermon. It makes the hills of Zion become wet. That is the place where the Lord has promised to bless his people.He blesses them with life for ever.

headings.text: God blesses his people

footnotes.text: Aaron was Moses' brother. He was the first priest that God chose to serve him. When the Israelites chose a new priest, they poured olive oil on his head to show that he was a special servant of God.
Dew is water that comes onto the ground at night. It helps plants to grow when there is no rain. Hermon is in the north of the land of Israel.
Mount Zion was the hill in Jerusalem where King Solomon built God's temple.

verses.text: Listen, all you servants of the Lord,come and praise the Lord!Praise the Lord,all you who serve him in his temple during the night.
Lift up your hands towards his Holy Place,and praise him.
The Lord made heaven and the earth.From his home in Zion, may he bless you!

headings.text: Praise God during the night

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the Lord!Praise him, you servants of the Lord!
You serve the Lord in his temple.You serve him in the temple yards.
The Lord is good, so praise him!His name is good and great,so praise him with songs!
The Lord has chosen Jacob's family for himself.Yes, he has chosen Israel's people to belong to him.
I know that the Lord is great.Our Lord is greater than any other god.
He does whatever he decides to do.He rules the sky and the earth,and the deepest parts of the sea.
The Lord causes clouds to rise up all over the earth.He sends lightning with the storms of rain.He sends out the wind from its place,so that it blows where he chooses.
God destroyed the firstborn sons in Egypt,both men and animals.
He did great miracles in Egypt.He warned Pharaoh and his officersthat he would punish them.
He destroyed many nationsand he killed powerful kings.
He killed Sihon, the king of the Amorites.He killed Og, the king of Bashan,and all the other kings of Canaan.
He gave their land to his people, the Israelites.The land would belong to themand to their descendants.
Lord, people will always remember your name.You will always be famous.
The Lord shows that his people are right.He is kind to those who serve him.
Other nations make idols with silver and gold.People worship things that they have made with their hands!
Their idols have mouths,but they cannot speak!They have eyes,but they cannot see!
They have ears,but they cannot hear!They cannot even breathe!
The people who made them will become like them.Everyone who trusts in idolswill become as useless as their idols.
Israel's family, praise the Lord! Descendants of Aaron, praise the Lord!
Descendants of Levi, praise the Lord!Everyone who serves the Lord, praise him!
Everyone in Zion should praise the Lord.He is the one who has his home in Jerusalem. Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: A song to praise God

footnotes.text: ‘Hallelujah’ means ‘Praise the Lord.’
God gave Jacob a new name, ‘Israel’. So ‘Jacob's family’ and ‘Israel's people’ both mean God's own people.

Verses 8-12: God brought his people out of Egypt and he took them to Canaan. God punished Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, because he would not let the Israelites go free. On the way to Canaan, God destroyed many kings and their people so that the Israelites could arrive in the land.

verses.text: Thank the Lord, because he is good!His faithful love will always continue.
Thank God, who rules all gods.His faithful love will always continue.

Thank the Lord God who rules all lords.His faithful love will always continue. The Lord alone does great miracles.He was wise when he made the skies.He put the earth across the water of the seas.He made the great lights to shine in the sky.He made the sun to rule over the day.He made the moon and the stars to rule the night.So thank the Lord!His faithful love will always continue. The Lord destroyed the firstborn sons in Egypt.He brought the Israelites out from among the Egyptians.He did this with his great power and strength.He cut the Red Sea into two separate parts.He led the Israelites through the middle of the sea.He threw Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea to drown.The Lord led his people through the wilderness.So thank the Lord!His faithful love will always continue. The Lord destroyed great kings.Yes, he killed powerful kings.He killed Sihon, the king of the Amorites.He killed Og, the king of Bashan.He gave their land to his people, the Israelites.He gave it to them as their own land.So thank the Lord!His faithful love will always continue. The Lord thought about us when we were upset.He saved us from the power of our enemies.He gives food to everything that lives.So thank the Lord!His faithful love will always continue.
Yes, thank the God of heaven!His faithful love will always continue.

headings.text: God's faithful love will always continue
In this psalm, one group sings some words and another group answers them. One group tells something that is true about God, the
Lord
. The other people repeat these words: ‘His
faithful
love will always continue.’

footnotes.text: These verses thank God because of the universe that he has made.

These verses thank God because he rescued his people from Egypt, where they had been slaves. The Red Sea is between Egypt and the desert. The Israelites had to go across the Red Sea to escape from Egypt.
These verses thank God because he took his people to a new land as their home, Canaan.
These verses thank God because he continues to take care of his people.

verses.text: When we sat down beside the rivers in Babylon,we were very upset.We thought about Zion that we had left behind,and we wept.
We hung up our harps there,on the branches of the willow trees.
Our enemies asked us to sing songs for them there.They laughed at us as their prisoners.They asked for a song to make them happy.They shouted, ‘Sing us a song about Zion!’
But we are in a foreign land,so we cannot sing a song to the Lord.
Jerusalem, I never want to forget you.I would rather lose my right hand!
I would rather my tongue could no longer move!Yes, I will always remember you, Jerusalem.You are the most important thing that I think about,more than anything else that makes me happy.
Lord, remember to punish the people of Edom. They were happy when Babylon's army won against Jerusalem.On that day, the Edomites said,‘Knock down the city so that nothing still stands!’
People of Babylon, an army will soon destroy you!They will punish you in the same way that you punished us.May God bless whoever does that to you!
They will hit your babies against a rock.May God bless whoever does that to you!

headings.text: A sad song in a foreign land
In 586
BC
, Babylon's army destroyed Jerusalem, the capital city of Judah. They took the people who lived in Jerusalem to Babylon as
prisoners
. Babylon was a city on the Euphrates River which was very rich and powerful. The king of Babylon ruled many other countries. Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon who attacked Jerusalem.

footnotes.text: Mount Zion was the hill in Jerusalem where God's temple was.
Edom was an enemy of Judah. When Babylon's army destroyed Jerusalem, the Edomites were very happy.

verses.text: I will thank you, Lord with all that I am.I will sing and praise you in front of the gods.

I look towards your holy temple,and I bend down to worship you.I thank you for who you are.You love your people with a faithful loveand they can always trust you.You are more famous than anyone,because you always do what you promise.
When I prayed to you, you answered me.You made me brave and strong.
All the kings in the world will thank you, Lord,when they hear the promises that you have made.
They will sing about the things that you have done,because they see that you are great, Lord.
Yes, the Lord is high above the earth,but he takes care of humble people.He also knows what proud people are doing,even if they are far away.
When there is danger all around me,you help me to be strong.When my enemy is angry,you fight against him.You save me with your strong right hand.
The Lord will do what he has promised for me.Yes, Lord, your faithful love will always continue.You have made us who we are,so do not leave us now!

headings.text: Thank God for who he is

footnotes.text: ‘gods’ or ‘angels’. David may be telling the false gods that the Lord is the only true God.
God's ‘strong right hand’ means his power to do great things.

verses.text: Lord, you look deep inside me,and you know all about me.
You know when I sit down,and you know when I get up.Even when you are far away,you understand what I am thinking about.
You see me when I go out,and you see me when I stay at home.You know everything that I do!
Yes Lord, before I open my mouth to speak,you know what I will say.
You are all around me, in front of me and behind me.You put your hand on me to help me.
You know so much about me, it is wonderful.I cannot understand it.My thoughts cannot reach as high as that!
Is there anywhere that I can goto run away from your Spirit?Anywhere that I go, you are already there!
If I go up to heaven,you would be there.If I dig deep down into the ground to reach Sheol,you would be there too.
If I fly away to where the sun rises in the east,or to the other side of the sea in the west,you would be there.
You would use your hand to lead me, even there.Your strong right hand would keep me safe.
I might say, ‘I will hide myself in the dark,and the light around me will change into night.’
But it is never too dark for you to see.For you, the night has as much light as the day. Darkness and light are the same to you!
You made every part of me.You made me grow inside my mother before I was born.
I thank you for the wonderful way that you have made me.Everything that you do is wonderful!I know all this is true.
While you caused me to grow in a secret place,none of my body was hidden from you.You made me deep in the earth.
Your eyes watched me before I was born.Before I had seen the light of day,you decided how many days I would live!You wrote it down in your book.
You have so many thoughts about me, God,that I cannot understand them all.
They are too many for me to count,more than the sand on the shore of the sea.Even if I finished counting them,you would still be there!
God, you should surely destroy the wicked people!Yes, you murderers, go away from me!
Those people say bad things against you, God.Your enemies always tell lies.
Lord, I hate those people who hate you.I do not respect those who turn against you.
Yes, I really hate them.Your enemies are my enemies too.
God, please look deep inside me.See what is there in my thoughts.
Show me if I am following any evil way.Lead me in the right way that has always been true.

headings.text: God knows all about me

footnotes.text: ‘A secret place’ and ‘deep in the earth’ probably mean inside his mother before he was born.

verses.text: Lord, please save me from evil people. Rescue me from people who are violent.
They think of evil ideas to hurt people.They only want to cause trouble!
Their words hurt people,like the tongue of a snake.They bite with poison,like a dangerous snake.
Lord, keep me safe from the power of wicked people. Protect me from violent people who want to attack me.
Proud people have prepared a trap to catch me.They have put their nets across my path.
Lord, I say to you, ‘You are my God.’ Lord, please hear my prayer for help!
Lord, my Lord, you are my strong helper.You protect my head when I fight in a battle.
Lord, do not let wicked people do what they want to do.Stop them when they prepare to attack.
Stop the people who are ready to attack me!Let the bad things that they say against mehappen to them instead!
Drop burning coals on them like rain!Throw those people into the fire!Let them fall into deep holes that they cannot get out of!
People who tell cruel lies should not live in our land.Trouble will happen to violent people. Terrible trouble will knock them down!
I know that the Lord helps poor people.He makes sure that they receive justice.
Your righteous people will always praise you.Good, honest people will live with you.

headings.text: A prayer for help against evil people

footnotes.text: People used traps and nets to catch animals and birds. These bad people wanted to catch David. It is as if they hid their traps and nets to catch him.

verses.text: Lord, I am calling to you for help.Come to me quickly!Please listen to what I am saying.
I offer my prayer to you like incense.Please accept it when I raise my hands to you.Accept it like a gift that I offer to you in the evening.
Lord, keep my mouth safe,so that I do not speak bad things.
Do not let my mind want evil things.Do not let me join with wicked people,to do the same bad things that they do.I do not even want to eat their good food.

If a good man hits me because he loves me,he is being kind to me.If he shows me that I have done a wrong thing,that it is like olive oil on my head. I would not refuse it.I continue to pray against what wicked people do.
Wicked people will throw their rulers downfrom high rocks.Then people will agree that my words were true.

It will be like a farmer who ploughs his field,and breaks the earth into pieces.Just like that, they will break the bones of wicked people.They will throw their bones on the groundat the entrance to Sheol.
But I look to you for help, Almighty Lord.I need you to keep me safe.Do not let wicked people kill me.
They have prepared traps to catch me.Do not let me fall into the traps of those evil people.
May those bad people fall into their own traps!Then I will be free from their power.

headings.text: A prayer for help

footnotes.text: David is saying, ‘If a good man is angry with me, I will accept what he says. He is warning me because he loves me.’ Olive oil that is poured on someone's head gives honour to that person.

verses.text: I am calling to the Lord to help me.I ask him to be kind to me.
I tell him about all my problems.I tell him about all my trouble.
Even when I do not feel brave,you are still my guide, Lord.In the path where I walk,my enemies have prepared a trap to catch me.
Look at me!I have no friend here to help me.There is no safe place where I can go.Nobody thinks about what is happening to me.
Yes, Lord, I am calling to you to help me.You are my safe place where I can hide.You are all that I need in this world where I live.
Please listen to me as I cry to you.I am very upset!My enemies are trying to catch me.Save me from their power!They are stronger than I am.
Please take me out of this prison. Then I will praise your name.Your own good people will see how you have helped me.They will meet around me to praise you.

headings.text: God is a guide in times of trouble

footnotes.text: David wrote this song in a cave. It is a prayer that David prayed when his enemies were trying to catch him. There are two stories about David hiding in a cave. See 1 Samuel 22 and 1 Samuel 24.
The cave where David was hiding seemed like a prison to him. He could not leave safely unless God helped him.

verses.text: Lord, I pray to you for help.Please listen to me.Answer me, because you do what is right.I know that I can trust you.
Do not judge me, your servant.Nobody is righteous when they stand in front of you.
My enemies are chasing me.They knock me down to the ground.They make me live in dark places,like people who have been dead for a long time.
My strength is leaving meand I feel very upset.
I remember what happened many years ago.I think carefully about all the good things that you have done.
I raise my hands to pray to you.I need you to help me,like dry ground that needs rain.
Please answer me soon, Lord.I am losing my strength.Do not turn away from me.If you leave me, I will join those people who are going downinto the deep hole of death.
Every morning, help me to remember your faithful love,because I am trusting in you.Show me how I should live to please you.I know that I belong to you.
Lord, save me from my enemies.I run to you to keep me safe.
Teach me to do what pleases you,because you are my God.Let your kind Spirit lead me,so that I can walk in a safe place.
Your name is great, Lord,so please keep my life safe.You do what is right,so bring me out of all my trouble.
I am your servant and you love me.Please show your faithful love to meand destroy my enemies.Yes, kill all those people who want to kill me!

headings.text: A prayer for help in a time of danger

verses.text: Lord, I praise you!You are my great Rock!You teach me how to fight well.You show me how to use my weapons.
You always love me.You are the strong place where I am safe.You rescue me from the power of my enemies.You are like a shield for me.I know that I am safe with you.You give me power over nations.
Lord, why do you even think about men and women?Why do you take care of humans?
People soon pass away, just like a breath.Their life is like a shadow that soon disappears.
Lord, open up the heavens!Leave your home and come down to earth!Touch the mountains so that they burn with smoke.
Send bright lightning to frighten your enemies.Shoot your arrows at themso that they run away.
Put your hand down from heaven,and lift me up from the deep water. Save me from the power of foreign people.
Their mouths speak lies.Even when they make a promise,they are deceiving people.
I will sing to you a new song, God.I will make music to you on my harp.
You help kings to win against their enemies.You also save me, your servant David, from my enemies,when they try to kill me with their dangerous swords.
Keep me safe from the power of foreign people.They speak lies.Even when they make a promise, it is false.
When our sons are young,may they grow quickly, like strong plants.May our daughters become tall and beautiful,like the beautiful pillars in a king's house.
May our homes have plenty of different kinds of food.May our sheep have thousands of lambs,so that there is no space in our fields.
May our cows give birth to many babies.May our enemies never knock down our city's walls.May none of us become their prisoners.May nobody cry in our city's streets because they are afraid.
When God does that for a nation,the people are truly happy!If people know that the Lord is their God,they are truly happy!

headings.text: God makes his people strong

footnotes.text: The lightning is like arrows that come from God.
David feels as if he is in deep and dangerous water, because his enemies are giving him a lot of trouble.

verses.text: I will praise you, my God and my King.I will always say how great you are!
I will praise you every day!Yes, I will always say how great you are!
The Lord is great and we should always praise him!He is greater than anyone can understand!
Parents will tell their children about you.They will all praise your powerful acts.
They will speak about your great glory.I too will think carefully about your wonderful acts.
People will talk about the powerful things that you have done.I too will say how great you are!
Everyone will say how good and kind you are.They will sing with joy about your justice.
Yes, the Lord is very kind and patient!He shows how great his faithful love is.
The Lord is good to everyone.He takes care of everything that he has made.
Everything that the Lord has made will thank him.Your own people will praise you, Lord!
They will say that your kingdom has great glory!They will speak about your royal power.
Then everyone will agree that you do great things.They will know about the glory of your kingdom.
Your kingdom will remain for ever.You will rule as king through every generation.The Lord always does what he promises to do.He is faithful in everything that he does.
The Lord lifts up everyone who falls.He helps everyone who feels weak.
Everyone looks to you for help.You provide food for everything at the right time.
You are ready to give with an open hand.You give food to every living thing, as much as they need.
The Lord is fair in everything that he does.He always shows his faithful love.
The Lord is ready to help everyone,if they pray to him in an honest way.
He helps those who respect and obey him.He saves them when they call to him for help.
The Lord protects everyone who loves him,but he destroys all wicked people.
I will speak aloud to praise the Lord!Everyone who lives should praise his holy name for ever!

headings.text: God is great and he is kind
This psalm is an alphabet
poem
. In the
Hebrew
language, each verse starts with the next letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

footnotes.text: The second part of this verse is not in all copies of the Hebrew Bible.

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!I say to myself, ‘Praise the Lord!’
I will praise the Lord through all my life.While I am alive, I will always sing to praise my God.
Do not trust in human leaders.No human can save you.
When they die, they return to the ground.On that day, their plans come to an end.
The person who knows that the God of Jacob will help him is a happy person! If he trusts in the Lord as his God, he is happy.
The Lord made the skies, the earth and the sea.He also made everything that is in them.He always does what he has promised to do.
He helps poor people to receive justice.He gives food to the hungry.He makes people that are in prison go free.
The Lord makes blind people see again.The Lord lifts up people who have fallen down.The Lord loves people who are righteous.
The Lord takes care of strangers who live among us.He helps widows and children who have no family,but he stops wicked people doing what they want.
The Lord will rule as king for ever!Zion's people, he will always be your Godand your descendants' God.Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God who rules as King
The last five psalms all start and end with the
Hebrew
word ‘Hallelujah’, which means ‘
Praise
the
Lord

footnotes.text: Jacob was the ancestor of the Israelites. ‘The God of Jacob’ means the God that Jacob worshipped. So it also means the God that the Israelites worshipped, the Lord.

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!It is good to sing to praise our God!Yes, it is right to praise him and it makes us happy.
The Lord is building Jerusalem again.He is bringing home the Israelite exiles.
He makes people who are very sad well again. He helps their wounds to get better.
He decided how many stars there should be in the sky.He has given a name to each of them.
Our Lord God is great and very powerful.He understands everything!
The Lord gives help to poor people,but he knocks down wicked people to the ground.
Offer a song to the Lord,to thank him for what he has done.Make music with a harpto praise our God.
He fills the sky with clouds.He sends rain to make the earth wet.He causes grass to grow on the hills.
He gives food for the animals to eat.He feeds the young ravens when they cry.
If a horse is very strong,that does not please him.If a soldier is brave,that does not make him happy.
Who does make the Lord happy?People who respect him and obey him.People who trust him because they know he loves them.
Jerusalem's people, praise the Lord!Yes, Zion's people, praise your God!
Praise him because he makes your city's gates strong.He blesses the people who live there.
He causes your borders to be safe from your enemies.He gives you lots of the best wheat to eat.
He sends his commands to reach all the earth.Very soon the whole world knows what he wants.
He covers the earth with snow,like a white blanket.He puts white frost everywhere,like ashes that the wind blows.
He throws hail from the sky,like small stones.When he sends a cold wind,nobody can continue to stand.
Then he commands it all to melt.He makes the warm wind blow,and the ice becomes streams of water.
He sends his message to Jacob's descendants.He gives his rules and laws to Israel's people.
He has not done that for any other nation.They do not know his laws.Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God who is great and powerful

footnotes.text: God's people lived as exiles in Babylon for 70 years. Then God brought his people home to Jerusalem again. He helped them to be happy again.
A raven is a big, black bird.
God has given his people a city to live in. Zion was the special part of Jerusalem where God's Temple was built.
Israel is the new name that God gave to Jacob. So Jacob's descendants and Israel's people both mean the Israelites.

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!Praise the Lord from the sky above!Praise him high in the heavens.
Praise him, all his angels.Praise him, all his armies in heaven.
Praise him, sun and moon.Praise him, all bright stars.
Praise him, skies above,and the water above the sky.
They should all praise the name of the Lord.It was his command that created them.
He has fixed them in their places for all time.Nothing can change the command that he has given.
Praise the Lord from the earth!Praise him, sea monsters and all the deep seas.
Praise him, fire and hail, snow and clouds.Praise him, wind and storm, as you obey his commands.
Praise him, mountains and all hills.Praise him fruit trees and all trees in the forests.
Praise him, wild animals and farm animals.Praise him, snakes and birds.
Praise him, kings all over the world,and people of every nation.Praise him, princes and all rulers on earth.
Praise him, young men and young women.Praise him, old men, as well as children.
They should all praise the name of the Lord.Only the Lord's name is great above all other names.He is the king who rules over heaven and earth.
He has made his own people strong,so that other nations respect them.All the people who serve him should praise him.They are the people of Israel, who belong to him.Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God everywhere
The psalm has three parts:
Verses 1-6: Everything in the sky should
praise
the
Lord
Verses 7-10: Everything on the earth should praise the
Lord
Verses 11-14: All people should praise the
Lord

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!Sing a new song to worship the Lord.When his own people meet together,they should praise him.
People of Israel, be very happy,because God made you.People of Zion, be very happy,because God is your king.
Yes, dance to praise the name of the Lord.Take your harps and tambourinesand make music to praise him with your songs.
When the Lord's people serve him,it makes him happy.He is happy to help humble people,so that people respect them.
The people who belong to God should be very happy,because he has made them great.They should always sing with joy,even when they lie on their beds at night.
They should shout aloud to praise God,while they hold sharp swords in their hands.
That is how they must fight against other nations,to punish them for their sins.
They must tie up the foreign kings with chains,and put the rulers in prison.
They must do that to punish their enemiesin the way that is right.That is how God will cause his people to become great.Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God with a new song

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!Praise God in his temple.Praise him high in the sky,where he shows his great strength.
Praise God for the great things that he has done.Praise him because he is great and powerful.
Praise him with music!Yes! Use trumpets, harps and lyresto praise God!
Dance and hit drums to praise him! Make music with harps and flutesto praise him!
Make music with big cymbals and small cymbalsto praise him!
Everything that is alive should praise the Lord!Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

headings.text: Praise God with loud music

footnotes.text: The Israelites had musical instruments that are different from the ones that we use today. We do not always have the right names for them in English.
People hit drums with sticks or with their hands to make music.
